4: package org.yuzu.yuzu_emu.utils
5: 
6: import android.content.Context
7: import android.net.Uri
8: import android.provider.DocumentsContract
9: import java.util.Locale
10: 
11: /**
12:  * Counts games and bytes per configured folder.
13:  *
14:  * Reads the tree directly through the content resolver instead of going via
15:  * [GameHelper], which parses every ROM header to build library metadata. That
16:  * is far too expensive for a screen whose only job is to say "14 games, 22 GB",
17:  * and it needs the encryption keys loaded; counting files needs neither.
18:  */
19: object GameFolderScanner {
20: 
21:     /**
22:      * Extensions the library will actually import.
23:      *
24:      * Same set as [GameFormats] / loader.cpp. GameHelper imports by this
25:      * list, not only Game.extensions, so XCI/NCA/NSO/KIP and a file named
26:      * "main" actually appear in the library.
27:      */
28:     private val ROM_EXTENSIONS = GameFormats.LAUNCHABLE
29: 
30:     /**
31:      * Всё, что человек считает файлом игры - включая то, что сам эмулятор
32:      * не откроет.
33:      *
34:      * ncz/nsz/xcz - сжатые образы. Eden их не запускает, и в списке игр их
35:      * не будет никогда. Но лежат они в той же папке, занимают место, и
36:      * пользователь про них знает. Панель "Мои игры" показывает их честно,
37:      * помечая как незапускаемые, вместо того чтобы делать вид, что папка
38:      * пуста - именно эта пустота и выглядит как "эмулятор ничего не нашёл".
39:      */
40:     private val SHOWABLE_EXTENSIONS = GameFormats.LAUNCHABLE + GameFormats.COMPRESSED
41: 
42:     /** Файл этого типа эмулятор запустить не сможет. */
43:     fun isLaunchable(name: String): Boolean = GameFormats.isLaunchable(name)
44: 
45:     /**
46:      * Плоский список файлов игр ровно в этой папке, без захода вглубь.
47:      *
48:      * Отдельно от [listGames], потому что вопросы разные: тот отвечает
49:      * "что импортирует библиотека", а этот - "что лежит в папке". Без
50:      * рекурсии, без фильтра по тому, примет ли файл эмулятор, и без
51:      * ограничения по количеству.
52:      */
53:     fun listFilesFlat(context: Context, uriString: String): List<Entry> {
54:         val resolver = context.applicationContext.contentResolver
55:         val tree = runCatching { Uri.parse(uriString) }.getOrNull() ?: return emptyList()
56:         val children = childrenUriFor(tree) ?: return emptyList()
57:         val out = mutableListOf<Entry>()
58:         val cursor = runCatching {
59:             resolver.query(
60:                 children,
61:                 arrayOf(
62:                     DocumentsContract.Document.COLUMN_DISPLAY_NAME,
63:                     DocumentsContract.Document.COLUMN_MIME_TYPE,
64:                     DocumentsContract.Document.COLUMN_SIZE
65:                 ),
66:                 null, null, null
67:             )
68:         }.getOrNull() ?: return emptyList()
69: 
70:         runCatching {
71:             cursor.use {
72:                 while (it.moveToNext()) {
73:                     if (out.size >= MAX_ENTRIES) break
74:                     val name = it.getString(0) ?: continue
75:                     val mime = it.getString(1) ?: ""
76:                     val size = if (it.isNull(2)) 0L else it.getLong(2)
77:                     if (mime == DocumentsContract.Document.MIME_TYPE_DIR) continue
78:                     val ext = name.substringAfterLast('.', "").lowercase(Locale.ROOT)
79:                     if (ext in SHOWABLE_EXTENSIONS || name.lowercase(Locale.ROOT) in ROM_FILENAMES) {
80:                         out.add(Entry(name, size))
81:                     }
82:                 }
83:             }
84:         }
85:         return out.sortedByDescending { it.bytes }
86:     }
87: 
88:     /**
89:      * Filenames that are a game without having a game's extension.
90:      *
91:      * loader.cpp:GuessFromFilename treats a file literally called "main" as a
92:      * DeconstructedRomDirectory - an unpacked game, where the folder is the
93:      * title and "main" is its executable - and "00" as an NCA, which is how a
94:      * split dump names its first part. Both are ordinary in real libraries and
95:      * both were invisible here: the scanner only looked at extensions, so an
96:      * unpacked game showed up as an empty folder.
97:      */
98:     private val ROM_FILENAMES = GameFormats.NAMES
99: 
100:     /** True when this file is something the emulator can load. */
101:     private fun isRom(name: String): Boolean = GameFormats.isLaunchable(name)
102: 
103:     /**
104:      * Extensions that look like content but are never listed as games.
105:      *
106:      * Worth naming separately so the folder screen can say "3 files here are
107:      * not launchable" instead of pretending the folder is empty.
108:      */
109:     private val NON_GAME_EXTENSIONS = setOf("nso", "kip", "bin", "zip", "7z", "rar")
110: 
111:     data class Folder(
112:         val uriString: String,
113:         /** Last path segment, which is what the user recognises. */
114:         val displayName: String,
115:         val gameCount: Int,
116:         val totalBytes: Long,
117:         /** Files with a ROM-ish extension the library will not import. */
118:         val skipped: Int = 0,
119:         /** Depth this folder was scanned at, so the file list can match. */
120:         val depth: Int = 1,
121:         /** True when the folder could not be read at all. */
122:         val unreadable: Boolean = false
123:     )
124: 
125:     /**
126:      * Scans every configured game folder.
127:      *
128:      * Always descends into subdirectories, regardless of the folder's
129:      * `deep_scan` flag. That flag governs what the emulator's own library
130:      * importer does; using it here made the count depend on a setting the user
131:      * cannot see from this screen, and let the count disagree with the file
132:      * list beside it. A storage summary that says "14 games" must mean the same
133:      * fourteen files the list can show. [MAX_DIRECTORIES] keeps a pathological
134:      * tree from turning that into a hang.
135:      */
136:     fun scan(context: Context, stillWanted: () -> Boolean = { true }): List<Folder> {
137:         val dirs = runCatching { NativeConfig.getGameDirs() }.getOrNull() ?: return emptyList()
138:         return dirs.map { dir ->
139:             scanOne(context, dir.uriString, depthFor(dir.deepScan), stillWanted)
140:         }
141:     }
142: 
143:     /**
144:      * How deep the library looks: GameHelper uses 3 with deep scan on and 1
145:      * without, counting the folder itself as one level.
146:      *
147:      * Matching it matters. This used to walk the whole tree regardless, so a
148:      * game two directories down was counted here and ignored by the importer,
149:      * and the strip claimed a game the list could never show.
150:      */
151:     fun depthFor(deepScan: Boolean): Int = if (deepScan) 3 else 1
152: 
153:     /**
154:      * Subdirectories [SharedDataDirectory.ensureLayout] creates under the
155:      * data root. They are not a game library. Walking them on a 8 GB Mali
156:      * phone is what turned "search for games" into a crash: nand alone is
157:      * hundreds of NCAs, cache/shader grows without bound, and a parent
158:      * folder stacked on its child sent the walker through the same tree
159:      * twice.
160:      */
161:     private val LAYOUT_NAMES = setOf(
162:         "nand", "load", "cache", "sdmc", "keys", "config",
163:         "dump", "screenshots", "amiibo", "tas", "icons", "log",
164:         "play_time", "crash_dumps", "shader", "system", "contents",
165:         "registered", "user", "save"
166:     )
167: 
168:     fun isLayoutName(name: String): Boolean =
169:         name.lowercase(Locale.ROOT) in LAYOUT_NAMES
170: 
171:     /**
172:      * The comparable path of a SAF URI or a file path.
173:      * `content://…/tree/primary:Download/ed` and the same URI percent-encoded
174:      * both become `download/ed`, so a parent/child check does not depend on
175:      * how Android handed the string over.
176:      */
177:     fun pathOf(uri: String): String {
178:         val decoded = runCatching { Uri.decode(uri) }.getOrDefault(uri)
179:         val afterScheme = decoded.substringAfter("://", decoded)
180:         val tail = if (':' in afterScheme) decoded.substringAfterLast(':') else decoded
181:         return tail.trim('/').lowercase(Locale.ROOT)
182:     }
183: 
184:     /**
185:      * Drop a folder that is a parent of another selected folder, and drop
186:      * exact duplicates keeping the first. Nothing is invented: an empty
187:      * list stays empty, a single chosen folder stays that folder.
188:      *
189:      * This is the "folders in layers" report. A default `game_path` plus
190:      * the folder the user actually picked meant walking the parent (often
191:      * the data root) and the child, so nand/load/cache got scanned on top
192:      * of the real library and the launch died in the walker.
193:      */
194:     fun collapseLayers(uris: List<String>): List<String> {
195:         val paths = uris.map { pathOf(it) }
196:         val keep = BooleanArray(uris.size) { true }
197:         for (i in uris.indices) {
198:             for (j in uris.indices) {
199:                 if (i == j || !keep[i]) continue
200:                 val a = paths[i]
201:                 val b = paths[j]
202:                 if (a.isEmpty()) continue
203:                 if (b.startsWith("$a/")) keep[i] = false
204:                 if (a == b && j < i) keep[i] = false
205:             }
206:         }
207:         return uris.filterIndexed { i, _ -> keep[i] }
208:     }
209: 
210:     /** Scan one folder, for callers that have a uri rather than the config. */
211:     fun scanOneFolder(
212:         context: Context,
213:         uriString: String,
214:         deepScan: Boolean,
215:         stillWanted: () -> Boolean = { true }
216:     ): Folder = scanOne(context, uriString, depthFor(deepScan), stillWanted)
217: 
218:     /**
219:      * @param stillWanted спрашивается перед каждым каталогом. Отмена
220:      *   корутины НЕ прерывает обычный цикл и не выставляет флаг
221:      *   прерывания потока - Dispatchers.IO просто отпускает результат, а
222:      *   код продолжает читать диск. Поэтому признак передаётся явно.
223:      */
224:     private fun scanOne(
225:         context: Context,
226:         uriString: String,
227:         maxDepth: Int,
228:         stillWanted: () -> Boolean = { true }
229:     ): Folder {
230:         // Контекст приложения, а не тот, что передали.
231:         //
232:         // Обход папки живёт секунды, а вызывают его из фрагмента, который
233:         // за это время может закрыться - поворот экрана, уход в
234:         // «Настройки» за разрешением. Курсор ContentResolver держит
235:         // ссылку на контекст: если это контекст фрагмента, вся активность
236:         // вместе с макетами остаётся в памяти до конца обхода. У этого
237:         // экрана обход запускается при каждом onResume, и каждый поворот
238:         // добавлял ещё одну утёкшую активность.
239:         val resolver = context.applicationContext.contentResolver
240:         val name = displayNameOf(uriString)
241:         val tree = runCatching { Uri.parse(uriString) }.getOrNull()
242:             ?: return Folder(uriString, name, 0, 0, depth = maxDepth, unreadable = true)
243: 
244:         var count = 0
245:         var bytes = 0L
246:         var skipped = 0
247:         var readable = false
248: 
249:         // Iterative rather than recursive: a pathological tree should not be
250:         // able to overflow the stack on a screen this trivial.
251:         val queue = ArrayDeque<Pair<Uri, Int>>()
252:         queue.add((childrenUriFor(tree)
253:             ?: return Folder(uriString, name, 0, 0, depth = maxDepth, unreadable = true)) to maxDepth)
254: 
255:         var guard = 0
256:         val seen = HashSet<String>()
257:         while (queue.isNotEmpty() && guard < MAX_DIRECTORIES) {
258:             guard++
259:             // Прервать обход, когда результат уже никому не нужен.
260:             //
261:             // Экран закрыли или запросили новый обход: до 400 запросов к
262:             // хранилищу, каждый со своим курсором, продолжались бы
263:             // впустую. Пользователь ушёл, а телефон ещё несколько секунд
264:             // читает диск.
265:             if (!stillWanted()) break
266:             val (children, depth) = queue.removeFirst()
267:             val cursor = runCatching {
268:                 resolver.query(
269:                     children,
270:                     arrayOf(
271:                         DocumentsContract.Document.COLUMN_DOCUMENT_ID,
272:                         DocumentsContract.Document.COLUMN_DISPLAY_NAME,
273:                         DocumentsContract.Document.COLUMN_MIME_TYPE,
274:                         DocumentsContract.Document.COLUMN_SIZE
275:                     ),
276:                     null, null, null
277:                 )
278:             }.getOrNull() ?: continue
279: 
280:             readable = true
281:             // cursor.use закрывает курсор при выходе, НО не при исключении
282:             // внутри самого перебора: getString на битой строке кидает, и
283:             // раньше это исключение уходило наверх, обрывая весь обход.
284:             // Одна нечитаемая запись делала папку целиком "пустой".
285:             runCatching {
286:             cursor.use {
287:                 while (it.moveToNext()) {
288:                     val documentId = it.getString(0)
289:                     val displayName = it.getString(1) ?: ""
290:                     val mimeType = it.getString(2) ?: ""
291:                     val size = if (it.isNull(3)) 0L else it.getLong(3)
292: 
293:                     if (mimeType == DocumentsContract.Document.MIME_TYPE_DIR) {
294:                         // Пускать в очередь только новые каталоги.
295:                         //
296:                         // Провайдер вполне может вернуть один и тот же
297:                         // documentId дважды: сетевые и облачные хранилища
298:                         // делают это на папках, доступных по нескольким
299:                         // путям. Раньше такая пара каталогов гоняла обход
300:                         // по кругу, пока не упрётся в лимит 400 - и
301:                         // считала одни и те же файлы много раз.
302:                         if (depth > 1 && documentId != null && seen.add(documentId)) {
303:                             runCatching {
304:                                 queue.add(
305:                                     DocumentsContract.buildChildDocumentsUriUsingTree(
306:                                         tree, documentId
307:                                     ) to depth - 1
308:                                 )
309:                             }
310:                         }
311:                         continue
312:                     }
313: 
314:                     val ext = displayName.substringAfterLast('.', "").lowercase(Locale.ROOT)
315:                     if (isRom(displayName)) {
316:                         count++
317:                         bytes += size
318:                     } else if (ext in NON_GAME_EXTENSIONS) {
319:                         skipped++
320:                     }
321:                 }
322:             }
323:             }
324:         }
325: 
326:         return Folder(uriString, name, count, bytes, skipped, maxDepth, unreadable = !readable)
327:     }
328: 
329:     data class Entry(
330:         val name: String,
331:         val bytes: Long,
332:         /** Sub-path below the folder root, empty when the file sits at the top. */
333:         val relativePath: String = ""
334:     )
335: 
336:     /**
337:      * Lists the ROMs inside one folder.
338:      *
339:      * Descends into subdirectories, because [scanOne] does. When the two
340:      * disagreed the screen said "14 games" and then listed none of them: the
341:      * count walked the whole tree while this only ever read the top level, so
342:      * a library organised one-folder-per-game - which is the normal way to
343:      * keep them - looked empty. Anything the counter counts must be listable,
344:      * or the count is a lie.
345:      *
346:      * Read at the moment of asking rather than served from the library cache,
347:      * so a file copied over USB a second ago is listed and one deleted a second
348:      * ago is not.
349:      */
350:     fun listGames(
351:         context: Context,
352:         uriString: String,
353:         maxDepth: Int = 1,
354:         stillWanted: () -> Boolean = { true }
355:     ): List<Entry> {
356:         val resolver = context.applicationContext.contentResolver
357:         val tree = runCatching { Uri.parse(uriString) }.getOrNull() ?: return emptyList()
358:         val root = childrenUriFor(tree) ?: return emptyList()
359:         val out = mutableListOf<Entry>()
360: 
361:         // Same walk, same guard and the same depth as the counter, so the two
362:         // cannot drift apart again.
363:         val queue = ArrayDeque<Triple<Uri, String, Int>>()
364:         queue.add(Triple(root, "", maxDepth))
365:         var guard = 0
366:         val seen = HashSet<String>()
367: 
368:         while (queue.isNotEmpty() && guard < MAX_DIRECTORIES) {
369:             guard++
370:             if (!stillWanted()) break
371:             // Верхняя граница на размер ответа.
372:             //
373:             // Список строился без ограничений, а каждая запись - это
374:             // три строки. На папке с несколькими тысячами файлов (обычное
375:             // дело для дампа) он занимал десятки мегабайт, и всё это
376:             // передавалось в адаптер разом. На 3 ГБ памяти это тот самый
377:             // вылет по нехватке памяти при открытии папки.
378:             if (out.size >= MAX_ENTRIES) break
379:             val (children, prefix, depth) = queue.removeFirst()
380:             val cursor = runCatching {
381:                 resolver.query(
382:                     children,
383:                     arrayOf(
384:                         DocumentsContract.Document.COLUMN_DOCUMENT_ID,
385:                         DocumentsContract.Document.COLUMN_DISPLAY_NAME,
386:                         DocumentsContract.Document.COLUMN_MIME_TYPE,
387:                         DocumentsContract.Document.COLUMN_SIZE
388:                     ),
389:                     null, null, null
390:                 )
391:             }.getOrNull() ?: continue
392: 
393:             runCatching {
394:             cursor.use {
395:                 while (it.moveToNext()) {
396:                     if (out.size >= MAX_ENTRIES) break
397:                     val documentId = it.getString(0)
398:                     val name = it.getString(1) ?: continue
399:                     val mime = it.getString(2) ?: ""
400:                     val size = if (it.isNull(3)) 0L else it.getLong(3)
401: 
402:                     if (mime == DocumentsContract.Document.MIME_TYPE_DIR) {
403:                         if (depth > 1 &&
404:                             documentId != null &&
405:                             seen.add(documentId) &&
406:                             !isLayoutName(name)
407:                         ) {
408:                             runCatching {
409:                                 queue.add(
410:                                     Triple(
411:                                         DocumentsContract.buildChildDocumentsUriUsingTree(tree, documentId),
412:                                         if (prefix.isEmpty()) name else "$prefix/$name",
413:                                         depth - 1
414:                                     )
415:                                 )
416:                             }
417:                         }
418:                         continue
419:                     }
420: 
421:                     if (isRom(name)) {
422:                         out.add(Entry(name, size, prefix))
423:                     }
424:                 }
425:             }
426:             }
427:         }
428:         return out.sortedByDescending { it.bytes }
429:     }
430: 
431:     private fun childrenUriFor(tree: Uri): Uri? = runCatching {
432:         DocumentsContract.buildChildDocumentsUriUsingTree(
433:             tree,
434:             DocumentsContract.getTreeDocumentId(tree)
435:         )
436:     }.getOrNull()
437: 
438:     /**
439:      * The document URI of a file this scanner listed.
440:      *
441:      * The scanner records a name and a sub-path rather than a URI, because a
442:      * URI is large and most callers only want to count. Rebuilding it here
443:      * keeps that trade without making the folder screen re-walk the tree.
444:      *
445:      * Document ids under a tree are the tree's own id plus the relative path,
446:      * which is how the storage framework addresses children; when a provider
447:      * does not follow that shape the caller gets null and says so rather than
448:      * launching something wrong.
449:      */
450:     fun childUri(treeUriString: String, entry: Entry): Uri? = runCatching {
451:         val tree = Uri.parse(treeUriString)
452:         val rootId = DocumentsContract.getTreeDocumentId(tree)
453:         val suffix = if (entry.relativePath.isEmpty()) entry.name
454:                      else entry.relativePath + "/" + entry.name
455:         val childId = if (rootId.endsWith("/")) rootId + suffix else "$rootId/$suffix"
456:         DocumentsContract.buildDocumentUriUsingTree(tree, childId)
457:     }.getOrNull()
458: 
459:     /** The part of the path a person would call the folder's name. */
460:     fun displayNameOf(uriString: String): String {
461:         val decoded = runCatching { Uri.decode(uriString) }.getOrDefault(uriString)
462:         val tail = decoded.substringAfterLast(':', decoded.substringAfterLast('/'))
463:         return tail.substringAfterLast('/').ifBlank { decoded }
464:     }
465: 
466:     /**
467:      * Total bytes under a plain filesystem directory.
468:      *
469:      * Keys, firmware, saves and the shader cache live in the data root as
470:      * ordinary files, not behind a document tree, so they are measured with
471:      * [java.io.File] rather than the content resolver. Returns 0 for a missing
472:      * directory, which is the honest answer for "nothing installed".
473:      */
474:     fun directoryBytes(path: String?): Long {
475:         if (path.isNullOrBlank()) return 0L
476:         val root = java.io.File(path)
477:         if (!root.exists()) return 0L
478:         if (root.isFile) return root.length()
479: 
480:         var total = 0L
481:         var guard = 0
482:         val queue = ArrayDeque<java.io.File>()
483:         queue.add(root)
484:         while (queue.isNotEmpty() && guard < MAX_DIRECTORIES) {
485:             guard++
486:             val entries = queue.removeFirst().listFiles() ?: continue
487:             for (entry in entries) {
488:                 if (entry.isDirectory) queue.add(entry) else total += entry.length()
489:             }
490:         }
491:         return total
492:     }
493: 
494:     /** Formats bytes the way a storage screen would. */
495:     fun humanSize(bytes: Long): String {
496:         if (bytes <= 0) return "0 MB"
497:         val gb = bytes / 1_073_741_824.0
498:         if (gb >= 1.0) return String.format(Locale.US, "%.1f GB", gb)
499:         val mb = bytes / 1_048_576.0
500:         if (mb >= 1.0) return String.format(Locale.US, "%.0f MB", mb)
501:         return String.format(Locale.US, "%.0f KB", bytes / 1024.0)
502:     }
503: 
504:     /** Stops a symlink loop or an absurd tree from hanging the scan. */
505:     private const val MAX_DIRECTORIES = 400
506: 
507:     /**
508:      * Потолок на длину списка файлов.
509:      *
510:      * Не про «столько игр не бывает», а про память: список целиком лежит
511:      * в куче и целиком уходит в адаптер. Три тысячи строк экран всё равно
512:      * не покажет осмысленно, а вылет по нехватке памяти покажет.
513:      */
514:     private const val MAX_ENTRIES = 3000
515: }

249:             val opened = runCatching { context.startActivity(launch) }.isSuccess
250:             if (opened) {

252:                     .put("package", ext.pkg)
253:                     .put("message", "открыл «${ext.label}» — выберите игру у них")
254:                     .toString()

536:     private fun filterAndSearch(baseList: List<Game> = gamesViewModel.games.value) {
537:         val filteredList: List<Game> = when (currentFilter) {
538:             R.id.alphabetical -> baseList.sortedBy { it.title }
539:             R.id.filter_recently_played -> {
540:                 baseList.filter {
541:                     val lastPlayedTime = preferences.getLong(it.keyLastPlayedTime, 0L)
542:                     lastPlayedTime > (System.currentTimeMillis() - 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000)
543:                 }.sortedByDescending { preferences.getLong(it.keyLastPlayedTime, 0L) }
544:             }
545:             R.id.filter_recently_added -> {
546:                 baseList.filter {
547:                     val addedTime = preferences.getLong(it.keyAddedToLibraryTime, 0L)
548:                     addedTime > (System.currentTimeMillis() - 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000)
549:                 }.sortedByDescending { preferences.getLong(it.keyAddedToLibraryTime, 0L) }
550:             }
551:             else -> baseList
552:         }
553: 
554:         val searchTerm = binding.searchText.text.toString().lowercase(Locale.getDefault())
555:         if (searchTerm.isEmpty()) {
556:             ((binding.gridGames as? RecyclerView)?.adapter as? GameAdapter)?.submitList(
557:                 filteredList
558:             )
559:             gamesViewModel.setFilteredGames(filteredList)
560:             return
561:         }
562: 
563:         val searchAlgorithm = if (searchTerm.length > 1) Jaccard(2) else JaroWinkler()
564:         val sortedList = filteredList.mapNotNull { game ->
565:             val title = game.title.lowercase(Locale.getDefault())
566:             val score = searchAlgorithm.similarity(searchTerm, title)
567:             if (score > 0.03) {
568:                 ScoredGame(score, game)
569:             } else {
570:                 null
571:             }
572:         }.sortedByDescending { it.score }.map { it.item }
573: 
574:         ((binding.gridGames as? RecyclerView)?.adapter as? GameAdapter)?.submitList(sortedList)
575:         gamesViewModel.setFilteredGames(sortedList)
576:     }

318:         }

321:     private fun getGameDirsAndExternalContent(reloadList: Boolean = false) {
322:         val gameDirs = NativeConfig.getGameDirs().toMutableList()
323:         val externalContentDirs = NativeConfig.getExternalContentDirs().map {
324:             GameDir(it, false, DirectoryType.EXTERNAL_CONTENT)

327:         _folders.value = gameDirs
328:         if (reloadList) {
329:             reloadGames(true)

333:     private fun addExternalContentDir(path: String) {
334:         val currentDirs = NativeConfig.getExternalContentDirs().toMutableList()
335:         if (!currentDirs.contains(path)) {
336:             currentDirs.add(path)
337:             NativeConfig.setExternalContentDirs(currentDirs.toTypedArray())
338:             NativeConfig.saveGlobalConfig()
339:         }
340:     }

342:     private fun removeExternalContentDir(path: String) {
343:         val currentDirs = NativeConfig.getExternalContentDirs().toMutableList()
344:         currentDirs.remove(path)
345:         NativeConfig.setExternalContentDirs(currentDirs.toTypedArray())
346:         NativeConfig.saveGlobalConfig()
347:     }

24: object GameHelper {
25:     private const val KEY_OLD_GAME_PATH = "game_path"
26:     const val KEY_GAMES = "Games"
27: 
28:     var cachedGameList = mutableListOf<Game>()
29: 
30:     /**
31:      * Прошёл ли хоть один обход за этот запуск.
32:      *
33:      * Пустой cachedGameList не отличить от «ещё не смотрели»: и то и
34:      * другое даёт размер 0. Панель состояния принимала второе за первое
35:      * и шла сканировать диск, чтобы «проверить».
36:      */
37:     @Volatile
38:     var hasScanned = false
39:         private set
40: 
41:     private lateinit var preferences: SharedPreferences
42: 
43:     fun getGames(): List<Game> {
44:         val games = mutableListOf<Game>()
45:         val context = YuzuApplication.appContext
46:         preferences = PreferenceManager.getDefaultSharedPreferences(context)
47: 
48:         val gameDirs = mutableListOf<GameDir>()
49: 
50:         // Папка игр «по умолчанию» больше не появляется сама.
51:         //
52:         // Здесь читался старый ключ game_path и МОЛЧА добавлялся как
53:         // папка игр, причём с deepScan = true - обход на три уровня
54:         // вглубь. Пользователь такую папку не выбирал и в списке папок
55:         // её не видел; если она указывала на корень данных или на
56:         // родителя игровой папки, обход шёл по слоям вложенных
57:         // каталогов (nand, load, cache, sdmc - их создаёт ensureLayout)
58:         // и мешал запуску.
59:         //
60:         // Единственный источник папок теперь - конфиг, куда они попадают
61:         // только явным выбором пользователя. Устаревший ключ вычищается,
62:         // чтобы не всплыл позже.
63:         if (!preferences.getString(KEY_OLD_GAME_PATH, "").isNullOrEmpty()) {
64:             preferences.edit() { remove(KEY_OLD_GAME_PATH) }
65:         }
66:         gameDirs.addAll(NativeConfig.getGameDirs())
67: 
68:         // Слои: родитель + его ребёнок в одном списке. Оставляем только
69:         // более узкую папку, иначе обход идёт по одному дереву дважды и
70:         // заходит в nand/load/cache корня данных.
71:         val collapsed = GameFolderScanner.collapseLayers(gameDirs.map { it.uriString }).toSet()
72:         if (collapsed.size != gameDirs.size) {
73:             val kept = gameDirs.filter { it.uriString in collapsed }
74:             gameDirs.clear()
75:             gameDirs.addAll(kept)
76:             runCatching { NativeConfig.setGameDirs(gameDirs.toTypedArray()) }
77:         }
78: 
79:         // Без ключей заголовок ROM не расшифруется: getIsValid врёт или
80:         // пустой title, список выглядит «найденным» без обложек. Не кладём
81:         // такие записи и не затираем прошлый кэш пустотой.
82:         NativeLibrary.reloadKeys()
83:         val keysOk = runCatching { NativeLibrary.areKeysPresent() }.getOrDefault(false)
84:         if (!keysOk) {
85:             hasScanned = true
86:             cachedGameList = mutableListOf()
87:             return emptyList()
88:         }
89: 
90: 
91:         // Reset metadata so we don't use stale information
92:         GameMetadata.resetMetadata()
93:         // И обложки тоже. Нативный кэш чистился, а кэш Coil - нет, поэтому
94:         // иконка, прочитанная со старыми ключами, оставалась серым
95:         // квадратом навсегда: игра уже запускается, а картинку берут из
96:         // памяти и файл больше не читают.
97:         runCatching { GameIconUtils.clearCache() }
98: 
99:         // Remove previous filesystem provider information so we can get up to date version info
100:         NativeLibrary.clearFilesystemProvider()
101: 
102:         val mountedContainerUris = mutableSetOf<String>()
103:         mountExternalContentDirectories(mountedContainerUris)
104: 
105:         val badDirs = mutableListOf<Int>()
106:         gameDirs.forEachIndexed { index: Int, gameDir: GameDir ->
107:             val gameDirUri = gameDir.uriString.toUri()
108:             val isValid = FileUtil.isTreeUriValid(gameDirUri)
109:             if (isValid) {
110:                 val scanDepth = if (gameDir.deepScan) 3 else 1
111: 
112:                 addGamesRecursive(
113:                     games,
114:                     FileUtil.listFiles(gameDirUri),
115:                     scanDepth,
116:                     mountedContainerUris
117:                 )
118:             } else {
119:                 badDirs.add(index)
120:             }
121:         }
122: 
123:         // Remove all game dirs with insufficient permissions from config
124:         if (badDirs.isNotEmpty()) {
125:             var offset = 0
126:             badDirs.forEach {
127:                 gameDirs.removeAt(it - offset)
128:                 offset++
129:             }
130:         }
131:         NativeConfig.setGameDirs(gameDirs.toTypedArray())
132: 
133:         // Cache list of games found on disk
134:         val serializedGames = mutableSetOf<String>()
135:         games.forEach {
136:             serializedGames.add(Json.encodeToString(it))
137:         }

139:             remove(KEY_GAMES)

141:         }

144:         hasScanned = true

152:         mountExternalContentDirectories(mountedContainerUris)
153:         mountGameFolderContent(Uri.parse(game.path), mountedContainerUris)
154:         NativeLibrary.addFileToFilesystemProvider(game.path)
155:     }
156: 
157:     // File extensions considered as external content, buuut should
158:     // be done better imo.
159:     private val externalContentExtensions = GameFormats.CONTAINERS
160: 
161:     private fun scanContentContainersRecursive(
162:         files: Array<MinimalDocumentFile>,
163:         depth: Int,
164:         onContainerFound: (MinimalDocumentFile) -> Unit
165:     ) {
166:         if (depth <= 0) {
167:             return
168:         }
169: 
170:         files.forEach {
171:             if (it.isDirectory) {
172:                 scanContentContainersRecursive(
173:                     FileUtil.listFiles(it.uri),
174:                     depth - 1,
175:                     onContainerFound
176:                 )
177:             } else {
178:                 val extension = FileUtil.getExtension(it.uri).lowercase()
179:                 if (externalContentExtensions.contains(extension)) {
180:                     onContainerFound(it)
181:                 }
182:             }
183:         }
184:     }
185: 
186:     private fun addGamesRecursive(
187:         games: MutableList<Game>,
188:         files: Array<MinimalDocumentFile>,
189:         depth: Int,
190:         mountedContainerUris: MutableSet<String>
191:     ) {
192:         if (depth <= 0) {
193:             return
194:         }
195: 
196:         files.forEach {
197:             if (it.isDirectory) {
198:                 addGamesRecursive(
199:                     games,
200:                     FileUtil.listFiles(it.uri),
201:                     depth - 1,
202:                     mountedContainerUris
203:                 )
204:             } else {
205:                 val extension = FileUtil.getExtension(it.uri).lowercase()
206:                 val filePath = it.uri.toString()
207: 
208:                 if (externalContentExtensions.contains(extension) &&
209:                     mountedContainerUris.add(filePath)) {
210:                     NativeLibrary.addGameFolderFileToFilesystemProvider(filePath)
211:                 }
212: 
213:                 // Game.extensions — урезанный список. Ядро открывает
214:                 // ещё nso/kip и файлы main/00 (loader.cpp).
215:                 val filename = FileUtil.getFilename(it.uri)
216:                 if (Game.extensions.contains(extension) || GameFormats.isLaunchable(filename)) {
217:                     val game = getGame(it.uri, true, false)
218:                     if (game != null) {
219:                         games.add(game)
220:                     }
221:                 }
222:             }
223:         }
224:     }
225: 
226:     private fun mountExternalContentDirectories(mountedContainerUris: MutableSet<String>) {
227:         val uniqueExternalContentDirs = linkedSetOf<String>()
228:         NativeConfig.getExternalContentDirs().forEach { externalDir ->
229:             if (externalDir.isNotEmpty()) {
230:                 uniqueExternalContentDirs.add(externalDir)
231:             }
232:         }
233: 
234:         for (externalDir in uniqueExternalContentDirs) {
235:             val externalDirUri = externalDir.toUri()
236:             if (FileUtil.isTreeUriValid(externalDirUri)) {
237:                 scanContentContainersRecursive(FileUtil.listFiles(externalDirUri), 3) {
238:                     val containerUri = it.uri.toString()
239:                     if (mountedContainerUris.add(containerUri)) {
240:                         NativeLibrary.addFileToFilesystemProvider(containerUri)
241:                     }
242:                 }
243:             }
244:         }
245:     }
246: 
247:     private fun mountGameFolderContent(gameUri: Uri, mountedContainerUris: MutableSet<String>) {
248:         if (gameUri.scheme == "content") {
249:             val parentUri = getParentDocumentUri(gameUri) ?: return
250:             scanContentContainersRecursive(FileUtil.listFiles(parentUri), 1) {
251:                 val containerUri = it.uri.toString()
252:                 if (mountedContainerUris.add(containerUri)) {
253:                     NativeLibrary.addGameFolderFileToFilesystemProvider(containerUri)
254:                 }
255:             }
256:             return
257:         }
258: 
259:         val gameFile = File(gameUri.path ?: gameUri.toString())
260:         val parentDir = gameFile.parentFile ?: return
261:         parentDir.listFiles()?.forEach { sibling ->
262:             if (!sibling.isFile) {
263:                 return@forEach
264:             }
265: 
266:             val extension = sibling.extension.lowercase()
267:             if (externalContentExtensions.contains(extension)) {
268:                 val containerUri = Uri.fromFile(sibling).toString()
269:                 if (mountedContainerUris.add(containerUri)) {
270:                     NativeLibrary.addGameFolderFileToFilesystemProvider(containerUri)
271:                 }
272:             }
273:         }
274:     }
275: 
276:     private fun getParentDocumentUri(uri: Uri): Uri? {
277:         return try {
278:             val documentId = DocumentsContract.getDocumentId(uri)
279:             val separatorIndex = documentId.lastIndexOf('/')
280:             if (separatorIndex == -1) {
281:                 null
282:             } else {
283:                 val parentDocumentId = documentId.substring(0, separatorIndex)
284:                 DocumentsContract.buildDocumentUriUsingTree(uri, parentDocumentId)
285:             }
286:         } catch (_: Exception) {
287:             null
288:         }
289:     }
290: 
291:     fun getGame(
292:         uri: Uri,
293:         addedToLibrary: Boolean,
294:         registerFilesystemProvider: Boolean = true
295:     ): Game? {
296:         val filePath = uri.toString()
297:         if (!GameMetadata.getIsValid(filePath)) {
298:             return null
299:         }
300: 
301:         if (registerFilesystemProvider) {
302:             // Needed to update installed content information
303:             NativeLibrary.addFileToFilesystemProvider(filePath)
304:         }
305: 
306:         var name = GameMetadata.getTitle(filePath)
307: 
308:         // If the game's title field is empty, use the filename.
309:         if (name.isEmpty()) {
310:             name = FileUtil.getFilename(uri)
311:         }
312:         var programId = GameMetadata.getProgramId(filePath)
313: 
314:         // If the game's ID field is empty, use the filename without extension.
315:         if (programId.isEmpty()) {
316:             programId = name.substring(0, name.lastIndexOf("."))
317:         }
318: 
319:         val newGame = Game(
320:             name,
321:             filePath,
322:             programId,
323:             GameMetadata.getDeveloper(filePath),
324:             GameMetadata.getVersion(filePath, false),
325:             GameMetadata.getIsHomebrew(filePath)
326:         )
327: 
328:         if (addedToLibrary) {
329:             val addedTime = preferences.getLong(newGame.keyAddedToLibraryTime, 0L)
330:             if (addedTime == 0L) {
331:                 preferences.edit()
332:                     .putLong(newGame.keyAddedToLibraryTime, System.currentTimeMillis())
333:                     .apply()
334:             }
335:         }
336: 
337:         return newGame
338:     }
339: }

1: # Symbiosis
2: 
3: A fork of the [Eden](https://git.eden-emu.dev/eden-emu/eden) Android emulator, tuned for
4: **ARM Mali GPUs on 8 GB devices where no custom Vulkan driver can be installed**.
5: 
6: Target hardware for this work: **Mali-G57 MC2 / MediaTek MT6789, 8 GB RAM (~5 GB usable)**.
7: 
8: ---
9: 
10: ## Why this fork exists
11: 
12: Stock Eden assumes a desktop-class GPU or an Adreno with replaceable drivers. On Mali:
13: 
14: - **OpenGL is unavailable.** Eden's GL renderer requires desktop OpenGL 4.6
15:   (`gl_device.cpp:163` throws otherwise); Android offers GLES 3.2. Vulkan is the only path.
16: - **No custom drivers.** Unlike Adreno, there is no widely deployed Turnip/adrenotools
17:   equivalent. The vendor blob is all there is.
18: - **Eden has no Mali knowledge.** `vulkan_device.cpp` carries a large Qualcomm quirk block;
19:   for ARM there is nothing, even though a Bifrost G71 and an Immortalis G720 differ enormously.
20: 
21: ## Settings are requests, not guarantees
22: 
23: The core insight behind this fork. Between a toggle and the GPU sit silent filters that
24: never report back, so a setting can stay on while doing nothing:
25: 
26: | Setting | Gate | Effect on Mali |
27: |---|---|---|
28: | `astc_recompression` | `!device.IsOptimalAstcSupported()` — `maxwell_to_vk.cpp:248` | **Dead.** Mali decodes ASTC in hardware, so the value is read and discarded. |
29: | `force_max_clock` | `ShouldBoostClocks()` — `vulkan_device.cpp:947` | **Dead.** The allow-list names AMD, NVIDIA, Intel, Qualcomm, Samsung. ARM is absent. |
30: | `use_vsync` | `ChooseSwapPresentMode()` — `vk_swapchain.cpp:44` | **Renegotiated silently** against surface capabilities; caps the frame rate. |
31: | `use_asynchronous_shaders` | `vk_pipeline_cache.cpp:353` | Survives, but worker count collapses to 1 on fragile drivers. |
32: 
33: The **launch report** (Diagnostics → Launch report, or the overlay button next to the FPS
34: counter) states, per setting, whether it reached the renderer, what it became if not, and
35: which line of code decided that.
36: 
37: ---
38: 
39: ## Repository layout
40: 
41: ```
42: patch/
43:   symbiosis/              C++ layer, ~6500 lines (src/common/symbiosis/)
44:   shaders/                present_retro.frag
45:   android/                Kotlin fragments, adapters, utils, layouts, strings
46:   native_symbiosis.cpp    JNI bridge, 53 entry points
47:   upstream_changes.patch  git diff against upstream Eden
48: tools/
49:   apply_patch.sh          restores the tree into a fresh Eden checkout
50:   setup_env.sh            JDK 17 + Android SDK/NDK + swap
51:   run_build.sh            gradle assembleLegacyDebug
52: tests/
53:   t_*.cpp                 host tests for the C++ layer
54:   SetupPageTest.kt        setup-page visibility logic
55:   test_l10n.py            Russian localisation checks
56: docs/
57:   BUGS.md                 every bug found, with evidence
58: ```
59: 
60: ## Building
61: 
62: **Builds run in GitHub Actions, not on a workstation.** Go to the
63: [Actions tab](https://github.com/sj0404-collab/symbiosis/actions), pick
64: **Build APK**, press *Run workflow*. About 25 minutes; the APK is attached as an
65: artefact and, if the box is ticked, uploaded to gofile.io with its MD5 printed
66: in the run summary.
67: 
68: Three workflows:
69: 
70: | Workflow | Runs | Purpose |
71: |---|---|---|
72: | **Tests** | ~4 min | Host test suite, the localisation check and the agent/chat suite. Runs on every change to `tests/`, `tools/run_tests.sh`, the C++ layer or `agent/`. |
73: | **Build APK** | ~25 min | The above, then the full NDK build, then verifies the fixes are present in the produced APK. |
74: | **Panel APK** | ~5 min | The Symbiosis panel as a standalone, self-contained app. Independent of the emulator. |
75: 
76: ### Panel APK
77: 
78: The panel is a separate, much smaller app: the control panel for this account
79: and for the fork, with no emulator in it. **The pages are packaged inside the
80: APK**, so it opens with no connection; the network is used only for what the
81: panel actually does - the GitHub API, starting workflows, reaching a session
82: tunnel.
83: 
84: It is served to the WebView from `assets/panel/` under a private https origin
85: rather than `file://`, because the page keeps its token in `localStorage` and
86: calls `api.github.com`: a `file://` document gets an opaque origin, loses that
87: storage between launches and has its cross-origin requests blocked.
88: 
89: Because the pages ship in the APK, editing `docs/` no longer updates an
90: installed app on its own - rebuild and reinstall. The build verifies that each
91: page is really inside the APK and byte-identical to `docs/`, so a build that
92: quietly shipped an empty `assets/` fails instead of reaching a phone.
93: 
94: `ubuntu-latest` deliberately: Eden's native build is CMake + NDK and targets
95: Linux, and `windows-latest` would add path-length and line-ending failures for
96: no benefit.
97: 
98: Building locally is possible but not recommended — it needs ~6 GB of swap,
99: `kotlin.compiler.execution.strategy=in-process` to survive the OOM killer, and
100: takes over half an hour on a small machine:
101: 
102: ```bash
103: bash tools/setup_env.sh
104: git clone --depth 50 https://git.eden-emu.dev/eden-emu/eden.git /work/eden
105: bash tools/apply_patch.sh --patch ./patch --eden /work/eden
106: bash tools/run_build.sh
107: ```
108: 
109: ## Running the tests
110: 
111: ```bash
112: git clone --depth 50 https://git.eden-emu.dev/eden-emu/eden.git /tmp/eden
113: bash tools/apply_patch.sh --patch ./patch --eden /tmp/eden
114: bash tools/run_tests.sh --eden /tmp/eden
115: ```
116: 
117: Two traps the harness now guards against, both of which once made the suite
118: look green while checking nothing:
119: 
120: - **Never** put `<eden>/src/common` on the include path. Eden ships its own
121:   `common/assert.h`, which shadows the standard `<cassert>`; every `assert()`
122:   then expands to nothing.
123: - Eden's `logging.h` calls `format.get()`, which needs **fmt 10**. Ubuntu
124:   packages fmt 9, so set `FMT_INCLUDE` to a fmt 10 checkout — otherwise every
125:   test that touches the layer fails to compile and is skipped.
126: 
127: 11 of 14 tests build and run; the 3 that need most of `video_core` are reported
128: as SKIP, and the harness fails if that number grows.
129: 
130: ## Honest status
131: 
132: Everything here is verified on the host — unit tests, `llvm-nm` symbol checks,
133: `aapt2` resource dumps, and a clean re-apply of the patch onto a fresh clone.
134: **None of it has been tested on physical Android hardware**, because none is available
135: in the build environment. Where a conclusion is a guess, it is labelled as one.
136: 
137: ## Licence
138: 
139: GPL-3.0-or-later, matching upstream Eden.

(End of file - total 139 lines)
</content>

---

tools/
  apply_patch.sh          restores the tree into a fresh Eden checkout
  setup_env.sh            JDK 17 + Android SDK/NDK + swap
  run_build.sh            gradle assembleLegacyDebug
tests/
  t_*.cpp                 host tests for the C++ layer
  SetupPageTest.kt        setup-page visibility logic
  test_l10n.py            Russian localisation checks
docs/
  BUGS.md                 every bug found, with evidence
```

## Building

**Builds run in GitHub Actions, not on a workstation.** Go to the
[Actions tab](https://github.com/sj0404-collab/symbiosis/actions), pick
**Build APK**, press *Run workflow*. About 25 minutes; the APK is attached as an
artefact and, if the box is ticked, uploaded to gofile.io with its MD5 printed
in the run summary.

Three workflows:

| Workflow | Runs | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| **Tests** | ~4 min | Host test suite, the localisation check and the agent/chat suite. Runs on every change to `tests/`, `tools/run_tests.sh`, the C++ layer or `agent/`. |
| **Build APK** | ~25 min | The above, then the full NDK build, then verifies the fixes are present in the produced APK. |
| **Panel APK** | ~5 min | The Symbiosis panel as a standalone, self-contained app. Independent of the emulator. |

### Panel APK

The panel is a separate, much smaller app: the control panel for this account
and for the fork, with no emulator in it. **The pages are packaged inside the
APK**, so it opens with no connection; the network is used only for what the
panel actually does - the GitHub API, starting workflows, reaching a session
tunnel.

It is served to the WebView from `assets/panel/` under a private https origin
rather than `file://`, because the page keeps its token in `localStorage` and
calls `api.github.com`: a `file://` document gets an opaque origin, loses that
storage between launches and has its cross-origin requests blocked.

Because the pages ship in the APK, editing `docs/` no longer updates an
installed app on its own - rebuild and reinstall. The build verifies that each
page is really inside the APK and byte-identical to `docs/`, so a build that
quietly shipped an empty `assets/` fails instead of reaching a phone.

`ubuntu-latest` deliberately: Eden's native build is CMake + NDK and targets
Linux, and `windows-latest` would add path-length and line-ending failures for
no benefit.

Building locally is possible but not recommended — it needs ~6 GB of swap,
`kotlin.compiler.execution.strategy=in-process` to survive the OOM killer, and
takes over half an hour on a small machine:

```bash
bash tools/setup_env.sh
git clone --depth 50 https://git.eden-emu.dev/eden-emu/eden.git /work/eden
bash tools/apply_patch.sh --patch ./patch --eden /work/eden
bash tools/run_build.sh
```

## Running the tests

```bash
git clone --depth 50 https://git.eden-emu.dev/eden-emu/eden.git /tmp/eden
bash tools/apply_patch.sh --patch ./patch --eden /tmp/eden
bash tools/run_tests.sh --eden /tmp/eden
```

Two traps the harness now guards against, both of which once made the suite
look green while checking nothing:

- **Never** put `<eden>/src/common` on the include path. Eden ships its own
  `common/assert.h`, which shadows the standard `<cassert>`; every `assert()`
  then expands to nothing.
- Eden's `logging.h` calls `format.get()`, which needs **fmt 10**. Ubuntu
  packages fmt 9, so set `FMT_INCLUDE` to a fmt 10 checkout — otherwise every
  test that touches the layer fails to compile and is skipped.

11 of 14 tests build and run; the 3 that need most of `video_core` are reported
as SKIP, and the harness fails if that number grows.

## Honest status

Everything here is verified on the host — unit tests, `llvm-nm` symbol checks,
`aapt2` resource dumps, and a clean re-apply of the patch onto a fresh clone.
**None of it has been tested on physical Android hardware**, because none is available
in the build environment. Where a conclusion is a guess, it is labelled as one.

## Licence

GPL-3.0-or-later, matching upstream Eden.

43: # calls reloadGlobalConfig() on every launch; ReadPathValues() begins with
44: # game_dirs.clear(), so the configured game folders are wiped each time a game

47: P="$PATCH_DIR"
48: E="$EDEN_DIR"
49: A="$E/src/android/app/src/main"
50:

210: path = sys.argv[1]

235:     open(path, 'w', encoding='utf-8').write(text)
236:     print('  declared KenjiPlayerActivity in :kenji')

238:     print('  ::warning:: KenjiProbeService missing; player activity not added')

240: 
241: # Keep the WebView across rotation. Without this MainActivity is destroyed,
242: # library.html reloads and every cover is decoded again — that is the lag.
243: python3 - "$MANIFEST" <<'PYROT'
244: import sys
245: path = sys.argv[1]
246: text = open(path, encoding='utf-8').read()
247: needle = 'android:name="org.yuzu.yuzu_emu.ui.main.MainActivity"'
248: if needle not in text:
249:     print('  ::warning:: MainActivity not in manifest; rotation keep not applied')

256:             android:exported="true"'''
257: new = '''            android:name="org.yuzu.yuzu_emu.ui.main.MainActivity"
258:             ''' + cfg + '''
259:             android:exported="true"'''
260: if cfg in text and old not in text:
261:     print('  MainActivity already keeps the WebView on rotate')
262: elif old in text:
263:     text = text.replace(old, new, 1)
264:     open(path, 'w', encoding='utf-8').write(text)
265:     print('  MainActivity keeps WebView on rotate')
266: else:
267:     print('  ::warning:: MainActivity block shape changed; rotation keep not applied')

269: 
270: # R8 rules for our own classes.
271: #
272: # A release build renames and deletes whatever R8 cannot see being used, and
273: # three things here are reached by NAME only: the probe service (a string in

275: # surfaces. Without these rules the release APK builds cleanly and then dies
276: # with ClassNotFoundException - in the one build type a person actually gets.
277: APP_DIR="$(cd "$A/../.." && pwd)"
278: cp "$P"/android/proguard-symbiosis.pro "$APP_DIR/proguard-symbiosis.pro"

280: if grep -q "proguard-symbiosis.pro" "$GRADLE"; then
281:   echo "  R8 rules already wired in"

283:   python3 - "$GRADLE" <<'PGEOF'
284: import sys
285: 
286: path = sys.argv[1]
287: text = open(path, encoding='utf-8').read()
288: 
289: # Appended to every proguardFiles(...) that already lists the project rules.
290: # Anchoring on that string rather than on a build type keeps this working if
291: # upstream adds or renames a variant.
292: needle = '"proguard-rules.pro"'
293: if needle not in text:
294:     print("  ::warning:: no proguardFiles entry found; R8 rules not wired in")
295: else:
296:     text = text.replace(needle, needle + ',\n                "proguard-symbiosis.pro"')
297:     open(path, 'w', encoding='utf-8').write(text)
298:     print("  wired proguard-symbiosis.pro into the R8 rules")
299: PGEOF
300: fi
301: 
302: 
303: # Kotlin
304: J="$A/java/org/yuzu/yuzu_emu"
305: cp "$P"/android/fragments/*.kt "$J/fragments/"
306: cp "$P"/android/adapters/*.kt  "$J/adapters/"
307: cp "$P"/android/utils/*.kt     "$J/utils/"

309: # Панель не обязана быть онлайн - она обязана работать.
310: if [ -d "$P/android/assets" ]; then
311:   mkdir -p "$A/assets"
312:   cp "$P"/android/assets/* "$A/assets/"
313:   echo "  copied assets: $(ls "$P/android/assets" | tr '\n' ' ')"
314: fi
315: 
316: # ui/ holds upstream screens this fork modifies wholesale rather than by diff.
317: if [ -d "$P/android/ui" ]; then
318:   cp "$P"/android/ui/*.kt "$J/ui/"
319: fi
320: if [ -d "$P/android/ui/main" ]; then
321:   cp "$P"/android/ui/main/*.kt "$J/ui/main/"
322: fi
323: if [ -d "$P/android/model" ]; then
324:   cp "$P"/android/model/*.kt "$J/model/"
325: fi
326: if [ -d "$P/android/activities" ]; then
327:   mkdir -p "$J/activities"
328:   cp "$P"/android/activities/*.kt "$J/activities/"
329:   mkdir -p "$A/java/org/kenjinx/android"
330:   if [ -d "$P/android/kenjinx" ]; then
331:     cp "$P"/android/kenjinx/*.kt "$A/java/org/kenjinx/android/"
332:     echo "  KenjinxNative shim installed"
333:   fi
334:   echo "  replaced activities: $(ls "$P/android/activities" | tr '\n' ' ')"
335: fi
336: 
337: # Resources
338: cp "$P"/android/layout/*.xml   "$A/res/layout/"
339: # Landscape variants of screens this fork modifies. Missing one made view
340: # binding type the view as nullable and failed the Kotlin compile.
341: if [ -d "$P/android/layout-land" ]; then
342:   cp "$P"/android/layout-land/*.xml "$A/res/layout-land/"
343: fi
344: # navigation/ is only present once a screen has been added to the graph.
345: if [ -d "$P/android/navigation" ]; then
346:   cp "$P"/android/navigation/*.xml "$A/res/navigation/"
347: fi
348: cp "$P"/android/drawable/*.xml "$A/res/drawable/"
349: # Merge, never replace. A wholesale copy silently drops any upstream string the
350: # fork's file predates: build #10 failed on "resource string/off not found"
351: # because v0.2.1's arrays.xml references strings my master-derived copy lacked.
352: python3 "$SELF_DIR/merge_strings.py" \
353:   "$A/res/values/strings.xml"    "$P/android/values/strings-en.xml" "$A/res/values/strings.xml"
354: python3 "$SELF_DIR/merge_strings.py" \
355:   "$A/res/values-ru/strings.xml" "$P/android/values/strings-ru.xml" "$A/res/values-ru/strings.xml"
356: 
357: # The Kotlin daemon is OOM-killed on a small machine; in-process is slower to
358: # start but survives.
359: GP="$E/src/android/gradle.properties"
360: # Gradle tuning depends on the machine, so decide it here rather than shipping
361: # one setting that is wrong everywhere.
362: #
363: # Upstream ships deliberately tiny limits (1.2 GB heap, one worker, no
364: # parallelism) so the build survives a small laptop. On a CI runner with four
365: # cores and 16 GB that is the difference between ~10 and ~25 minutes, and the
366: # native compile is entirely CPU-bound.
367: total_kb=$(awk '/MemTotal/{print $2}' /proc/meminfo 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
368: cores=$(nproc 2>/dev/null || echo 2)
369: 
370: python3 - "$GP" "$total_kb" "$cores" <<'PYTUNE'
371: import sys
372: 
373: gp, total_kb, cores = sys.argv[1], int(sys.argv[2]), int(sys.argv[3])
374: text = open(gp).read() if __import__("os").path.exists(gp) else ""
375: big = total_kb >= 7_000_000  # ~7 GB and up counts as a real build machine
376: 
377: if big:
378:     # Leave headroom for the Kotlin daemon and the C++ compilers, which live
379:     # outside the Gradle JVM.
380:     heap = min(6144, max(2048, total_kb // 1024 // 3))
381:     settings = {
382:         "org.gradle.jvmargs": f"-Xms512m -Xmx{heap}m -XX:MaxMetaspaceSize=1g -Dfile.encoding=UTF-8",
383:         "org.gradle.workers.max": str(cores),
384:         "org.gradle.parallel": "true",
385:         "org.gradle.caching": "true",
386:         "kotlin.parallel.tasks.in.project": "true",
387:         # A daemon can hold the Kotlin compiler in memory; only safe when there
388:         # is enough RAM that the OOM killer will not take it out mid-build.
389:         "kotlin.compiler.execution.strategy": "daemon",
390:         "kotlin.daemon.jvmargs": "-Xmx2g",
391:     }
392: else:
393:     settings = {
394:         "org.gradle.workers.max": "1",
395:         "org.gradle.parallel": "false",
396:         # In-process, because a separate Kotlin daemon is the first thing the
397:         # OOM killer takes on a 2 GB machine.
398:         "kotlin.compiler.execution.strategy": "in-process",
399:     }
400: 
401: lines, seen = [], set()
402: for line in text.splitlines():
403:     key = line.split("=", 1)[0].strip()
404:     if key in settings:
405:         if key in seen:
406:             continue
407:         seen.add(key)
408:         lines.append(f"{key}={settings[key]}")
409:     else:
410:         lines.append(line)
411: 
412: for key, value in settings.items():
413:     if key not in seen:
414:         lines.append(f"{key}={value}")
415: 
416: open(gp, "w").write("\n".join(lines) + "\n")
417: print(f"gradle tuned for {'a large' if big else 'a small'} machine: "
418:       f"{total_kb // 1024} MB RAM, {cores} cores")
419: PYTUNE
420: 
421: changed=$(git status --porcelain | wc -l)
422: echo "PATCH_APPLIED files=$changed"
423: if [ "$changed" -lt 80 ]; then
424:   echo "ERROR: only $changed files changed; a complete apply touches ~87." >&2
425:   exit 1
426: fi

#   bash tools/apply_patch.sh --patch <dir> --eden <dir>
set -euo pipefail

# Resolved before any cd, otherwise BASH_SOURCE is relative to the new cwd.

PATCH_DIR="${PATCH_DIR:-/home/user/symbiosis-patch}"

display.text:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Restores the Symbiosis tree into a fresh Eden checkout.
#
# Written as a script because copying these files by hand was forgotten twice,
# and each miss cost a full 30-minute build that appeared to succeed while
# silently shipping the old code.
#
# Paths are arguments rather than constants so the same script serves the local
# sandbox and a CI runner; hard-coding /work/eden meant CI needed its own copy,
# and two copies drift.
#
# Usage:
#   bash tools/apply_patch.sh                          # sandbox defaults
#   bash tools/apply_patch.sh --patch <dir> --eden <dir>
set -euo pipefail

# Resolved before any cd, otherwise BASH_SOURCE is relative to the new cwd.
SELF_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"

PATCH_DIR="${PATCH_DIR:-/home/user/symbiosis-patch}"
EDEN_DIR="${EDEN_DIR:-/work/eden}"

while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
  case "$1" in
    --patch) PATCH_DIR="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --eden)  EDEN_DIR="$2";  shift 2 ;;
    *) echo "unknown argument: $1" >&2; exit 2 ;;
  esac
done

# When run from a checkout of this repository, default to its own patch/ dir.
if [ ! -d "$PATCH_DIR" ]; then
  if [ -d "$SELF_DIR/../patch" ]; then
    PATCH_DIR="$(cd "$SELF_DIR/../patch" && pwd)"
  fi
fi

[ -d "$PATCH_DIR" ] || { echo "patch directory not found: $PATCH_DIR" >&2; exit 1; }
[ -d "$EDEN_DIR" ]  || { echo "eden checkout not found: $EDEN_DIR"    >&2; exit 1; }

# PINNED TAG: this patch is cut against v0.2.1, not master. Upstream master
# carries b870bd255 "[android] config: load configuration on game start", which
# calls reloadGlobalConfig() on every launch; ReadPathValues() begins with
# game_dirs.clear(), so the configured game folders are wiped each time a game
# starts. v0.2.1 predates that.

P="$PATCH_DIR"
E="$EDEN_DIR"
A="$E/src/android/app/src/main"

echo "patch: $P"
echo "eden : $E"

cd "$E"

# --3way needs history, hence the depth-50 clone; the icon is excluded because
# a binary delete cannot be applied without a full index line.
# Capture the outcome rather than swallowing it. A shallow clone makes --3way
# fall back to direct application, which drops files and still exits 0 - the
# build then succeeds against a half-applied patch, which is worse than failing.
apply_log=$(git apply --3way --exclude='*ic_launcher_foreground.png' \
  "$P/upstream_changes.patch" 2>&1 || true)
printf '%s\n' "$apply_log" | grep -v cleanly || true

if printf '%s' "$apply_log" | grep -q "lacks the necessary blob"; then
  echo "ERROR: shallow checkout. git apply --3way needs full history:" >&2
  echo "  git clone --branch <tag> https://git.eden-emu.dev/eden-emu/eden.git" >&2
  exit 1
fi
if printf '%s' "$apply_log" | grep -q "patch does not apply"; then
  echo "ERROR: the patch does not apply to this checkout." >&2
  exit 1
fi
if git status --porcelain | grep -qE '^(UU|AA)'; then
  echo "ERROR: unresolved conflicts:" >&2
  git status --porcelain | grep -E '^(UU|AA)' >&2
  exit 1
fi
rm -f "$A/res/drawable/ic_launcher_foreground.png"

# C++ layer
mkdir -p "$E/src/common/symbiosis"
cp "$P"/symbiosis/*.cpp "$P"/symbiosis/*.h "$E/src/common/symbiosis/"

# Shader
cp "$P"/shaders/present_retro.frag "$E/src/video_core/host_shaders/"

# JNI bridge
cp "$P"/native_symbiosis.cpp "$A/jni/"

# Upstream JNI sources this fork replaces wholesale.
#
# game_metadata.cpp is here rather than in the diff because the changes are
# spread across every function in the file - a null check, a mutex, and the
# removal of a by-value return that copied a half-megabyte icon per call.
# Expressed as a diff that is one hunk per function, and each one shifts the
# line numbers of the next; the file is 160 lines, so shipping it whole is
# both smaller and immune to the hunk-offset arithmetic that has broken this
# patch twice already. It is already listed in jni/CMakeLists.txt upstream,
# so no build wiring changes.
if [ -d "$P/jni" ]; then
  cp "$P"/jni/*.cpp "$A/jni/"
  echo "  replaced JNI sources: $(ls "$P/jni" | tr '\n' ' ')"
fi

# The Kenji bridge is a SEPARATE library, appended to the jni CMakeLists rather
# than patched in by line number - upstream's file is 35 lines long and any
# hunk anchored past that simply fails to apply, silently taking the bridge out
# of the build. Appending is immune to the file changing length.
#
# Two names on purpose. Kotlin loads symbiosis_kenji; the core resolves
# DllImport("libkenjinxjni") at runtime and calls debug_break from inside
# deviceInitialize, so a missing libkenjinxjni.so aborts the process on the
# first device call. Same source, built twice, a few kilobytes each.
cp "$P"/symbiosis/kenji_bridge.cpp "$A/jni/symbiosis_kenji_bridge.cpp"
CM="$A/jni/CMakeLists.txt"
if ! grep -q "symbiosis_kenji" "$CM"; then
  cat >> "$CM" <<'CMAKE'

# ── Kenji-NX bridge ────────────────────────────────────────────────
add_library(symbiosis_kenji SHARED symbiosis_kenji_bridge.cpp)
target_link_libraries(symbiosis_kenji PRIVATE log dl android)

# The name the core itself looks for.
add_library(kenjinxjni SHARED symbiosis_kenji_bridge.cpp)
target_link_libraries(kenjinxjni PRIVATE log dl android)
CMAKE
  echo "  added the Kenji bridge to jni/CMakeLists.txt"
fi

# The probe service, and the reason it exists: a native abort kills its own
# process and nothing else. Declaring android:process=":kenji" means the first
# contact with a freshly downloaded core happens somewhere expendable - if it
# aborts, the launcher hears onServiceDisconnected and says so, instead of
# vanishing.
#
# Inserted with python rather than sed: the manifest is XML, and a regex that
# happens to match twice would produce a file that no longer parses.
MANIFEST="$A/AndroidManifest.xml"
python3 - "$MANIFEST" <<'PYEOF'
import sys

path = sys.argv[1]
text = open(path, encoding='utf-8').read()

if 'KenjiProbeService' in text:
    print('  manifest already declares the Kenji probe service')
    sys.exit(0)

service = """
        <!-- Loads the downloaded Kenji core in its own process, so a crash
             inside it cannot take the app down. -->
        <service
            android:name="org.yuzu.yuzu_emu.utils.KenjiProbeService"
            android:process=":kenji"
            android:exported="false" />
        <activity
            android:name="org.yuzu.yuzu_emu.activities.KenjiPlayerActivity"
            android:process=":kenji"
            android:exported="false"
            android:theme="@android:style/Theme.Black.NoTitleBar.Fullscreen"
            android:configChanges="orientation|screenSize|keyboardHidden|screenLayout"
            android:launchMode="singleTask" />
"""

marker = '</application>'
if marker not in text:
    print('  ::warning:: no </application> in the manifest; service not added')
    sys.exit(0)

text = text.replace(marker, service + '    ' + marker, 1)
open(path, 'w', encoding='utf-8').write(text)
print('  declared KenjiProbeService in :kenji')
PYEOF

# Android 11+ hides other packages unless we declare them. Without this
# Spaces.official() always looks empty even when Kenji is installed.
python3 - "$MANIFEST" <<'PYQ'
import sys
path = sys.argv[1]
text = open(path, encoding='utf-8').read()
if 'org.kenjinx.android' in text and '<queries>' in text:
    print('  queries already list Kenji')
    raise SystemExit(0)
block = '''
    <queries>
        <package android:name="org.kenjinx.android" />
        <package android:name="org.ryujinx.android" />
        <package android:name="org.ryujinx.kenjinx" />
        <intent>
            <action android:name="android.intent.action.MAIN" />
            <category android:name="android.intent.category.LAUNCHER" />
        </intent>
        <intent>
            <action android:name="android.intent.action.VIEW" />
            <data android:mimeType="*/*" />
        </intent>
    </queries>
'''
if '</manifest>' not in text:
    print('  ::warning:: no </manifest>; queries not added')
    raise SystemExit(0)
text = text.replace('</manifest>', block + '</manifest>', 1)
open(path, 'w', encoding='utf-8').write(text)
print('  declared package queries for official Kenji')
PYQ

python3 - "$MANIFEST" <<'PYKENJI'
import sys
path = sys.argv[1]
text = open(path, encoding='utf-8').read()
if 'KenjiPlayerActivity' in text:
    print('  KenjiPlayerActivity already in manifest')
    sys.exit(0)
act = '''
        <activity
            android:name="org.yuzu.yuzu_emu.activities.KenjiPlayerActivity"
            android:process=":kenji"
            android:exported="false"
            android:theme="@android:style/Theme.Black.NoTitleBar.Fullscreen"
            android:configChanges="orientation|screenSize|keyboardHidden|screenLayout"
            android:launchMode="singleTask" />
'''
if 'KenjiProbeService' in text:
    text = text.replace('android:name="org.yuzu.yuzu_emu.utils.KenjiProbeService"',
                        'android:name="org.yuzu.yuzu_emu.utils.KenjiProbeService"', 1)
    # insert after the probe service tag
    marker = 'android:name="org.yuzu.yuzu_emu.utils.KenjiProbeService"'
    i = text.find(marker)
    end = text.find('/>', i)
    if end < 0:
        print('  ::warning:: probe service tag not closed; player activity not added')
        sys.exit(0)
    text = text[:end+2] + act + text[end+2:]
    open(path, 'w', encoding='utf-8').write(text)
    print('  declared KenjiPlayerActivity in :kenji')
else:
    print('  ::warning:: KenjiProbeService missing; player activity not added')
PYKENJI

# Keep the WebView across rotation. Without this MainActivity is destroyed,
# library.html reloads and every cover is decoded again — that is the lag.
python3 - "$MANIFEST" <<'PYROT'
import sys
path = sys.argv[1]
text = open(path, encoding='utf-8').read()
needle = 'android:name="org.yuzu.yuzu_emu.ui.main.MainActivity"'
if needle not in text:
    print('  ::warning:: MainActivity not in manifest; rotation keep not applied')
    sys.exit(0)
if 'orientation|screenSize' in text and needle in text:
    # already has some configChanges near the file; still ensure MainActivity has it
    pass
cfg = 'android:configChanges="orientation|screenSize|smallestScreenSize|screenLayout|keyboardHidden|uiMode"'
old = '''            android:name="org.yuzu.yuzu_emu.ui.main.MainActivity"
            android:exported="true"'''
new = '''            android:name="org.yuzu.yuzu_emu.ui.main.MainActivity"
            ''' + cfg + '''
            android:exported="true"'''
if cfg in text and old not in text:
    print('  MainActivity already keeps the WebView on rotate')
elif old in text:
    text = text.replace(old, new, 1)
    open(path, 'w', encoding='utf-8').write(text)
    print('  MainActivity keeps WebView on rotate')
else:
    print('  ::warning:: MainActivity block shape changed; rotation keep not applied')
PYROT

# R8 rules for our own classes.
#
# A release build renames and deletes whatever R8 cannot see being used, and
# three things here are reached by NAME only: the probe service (a string in
# the manifest), EnginesFragment (created by the navigation graph) and the JNI
# surfaces. Without these rules the release APK builds cleanly and then dies
# with ClassNotFoundException - in the one build type a person actually gets.
APP_DIR="$(cd "$A/../.." && pwd)"
cp "$P"/android/proguard-symbiosis.pro "$APP_DIR/proguard-symbiosis.pro"
GRADLE="$APP_DIR/build.gradle.kts"
if grep -q "proguard-symbiosis.pro" "$GRADLE"; then
  echo "  R8 rules already wired in"
else
  python3 - "$GRADLE" <<'PGEOF'
import sys

path = sys.argv[1]
text = open(path, encoding='utf-8').read()

# Appended to every proguardFiles(...) that already lists the project rules.
# Anchoring on that string rather than on a build type keeps this working if
# upstream adds or renames a variant.
needle = '"proguard-rules.pro"'
if needle not in text:
    print("  ::warning:: no proguardFiles entry found; R8 rules not wired in")
else:
    text = text.replace(needle, needle + ',\n                "proguard-symbiosis.pro"')
    open(path, 'w', encoding='utf-8').write(text)
    print("  wired proguard-symbiosis.pro into the R8 rules")
PGEOF
fi


# Kotlin
J="$A/java/org/yuzu/yuzu_emu"
cp "$P"/android/fragments/*.kt "$J/fragments/"
cp "$P"/android/adapters/*.kt  "$J/adapters/"
cp "$P"/android/utils/*.kt     "$J/utils/"
# Встроенная копия панели: та же страница, показывается когда сети нет.
# Панель не обязана быть онлайн - она обязана работать.
if [ -d "$P/android/assets" ]; then
  mkdir -p "$A/assets"
  cp "$P"/android/assets/* "$A/assets/"
  echo "  copied assets: $(ls "$P/android/assets" | tr '\n' ' ')"
fi

# ui/ holds upstream screens this fork modifies wholesale rather than by diff.
if [ -d "$P/android/ui" ]; then
  cp "$P"/android/ui/*.kt "$J/ui/"
fi
if [ -d "$P/android/ui/main" ]; then
  cp "$P"/android/ui/main/*.kt "$J/ui/main/"
fi
if [ -d "$P/android/model" ]; then
  cp "$P"/android/model/*.kt "$J/model/"
fi
if [ -d "$P/android/activities" ]; then
  mkdir -p "$J/activities"
  cp "$P"/android/activities/*.kt "$J/activities/"
  mkdir -p "$A/java/org/kenjinx/android"
  if [ -d "$P/android/kenjinx" ]; then
    cp "$P"/android/kenjinx/*.kt "$A/java/org/kenjinx/android/"
    echo "  KenjinxNative shim installed"
  fi
  echo "  replaced activities: $(ls "$P/android/activities" | tr '\n' ' ')"
fi

# Resources
cp "$P"/android/layout/*.xml   "$A/res/layout/"
# Landscape variants of screens this fork modifies. Missing one made view
# binding type the view as nullable and failed the Kotlin compile.
if [ -d "$P/android/layout-land" ]; then
  cp "$P"/android/layout-land/*.xml "$A/res/layout-land/"
fi
# navigation/ is only present once a screen has been added to the graph.
if [ -d "$P/android/navigation" ]; then
  cp "$P"/android/navigation/*.xml "$A/res/navigation/"
fi
cp "$P"/android/drawable/*.xml "$A/res/drawable/"
# Merge, never replace. A wholesale copy silently drops any upstream string the
# fork's file predates: build #10 failed on "resource string/off not found"
# because v0.2.1's arrays.xml references strings my master-derived copy lacked.
python3 "$SELF_DIR/merge_strings.py" \
  "$A/res/values/strings.xml"    "$P/android/values/strings-en.xml" "$A/res/values/strings.xml"
python3 "$SELF_DIR/merge_strings.py" \
  "$A/res/values-ru/strings.xml" "$P/android/values/strings-ru.xml" "$A/res/values-ru/strings.xml"

# The Kotlin daemon is OOM-killed on a small machine; in-process is slower to
# start but survives.
GP="$E/src/android/gradle.properties"
# Gradle tuning depends on the machine, so decide it here rather than shipping
# one setting that is wrong everywhere.
#
# Upstream ships deliberately tiny limits (1.2 GB heap, one worker, no
# parallelism) so the build survives a small laptop. On a CI runner with four
# cores and 16 GB that is the difference between ~10 and ~25 minutes, and the
# native compile is entirely CPU-bound.
total_kb=$(awk '/MemTotal/{print $2}' /proc/meminfo 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
cores=$(nproc 2>/dev/null || echo 2)

python3 - "$GP" "$total_kb" "$cores" <<'PYTUNE'
import sys

gp, total_kb, cores = sys.argv[1], int(sys.argv[2]), int(sys.argv[3])
text = open(gp).read() if __import__("os").path.exists(gp) else ""
big = total_kb >= 7_000_000  # ~7 GB and up counts as a real build machine

if big:
    # Leave headroom for the Kotlin daemon and the C++ compilers, which live
    # outside the Gradle JVM.
    heap = min(6144, max(2048, total_kb // 1024 // 3))
    settings = {
        "org.gradle.jvmargs": f"-Xms512m -Xmx{heap}m -XX:MaxMetaspaceSize=1g -Dfile.encoding=UTF-8",
        "org.gradle.workers.max": str(cores),
        "org.gradle.parallel": "true",
        "org.gradle.caching": "true",
        "kotlin.parallel.tasks.in.project": "true",
        # A daemon can hold the Kotlin compiler in memory; only safe when there
        # is enough RAM that the OOM killer will not take it out mid-build.
        "kotlin.compiler.execution.strategy": "daemon",
        "kotlin.daemon.jvmargs": "-Xmx2g",
    }
else:
    settings = {
        "org.gradle.workers.max": "1",
        "org.gradle.parallel": "false",
        # In-process, because a separate Kotlin daemon is the first thing the
        # OOM killer takes on a 2 GB machine.
        "kotlin.compiler.execution.strategy": "in-process",
    }

lines, seen = [], set()
for line in text.splitlines():
    key = line.split("=", 1)[0].strip()
    if key in settings:
        if key in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(key)
        lines.append(f"{key}={settings[key]}")
    else:
        lines.append(line)

for key, value in settings.items():
    if key not in seen:
        lines.append(f"{key}={value}")

open(gp, "w").write("\n".join(lines) + "\n")
print(f"gradle tuned for {'a large' if big else 'a small'} machine: "
      f"{total_kb // 1024} MB RAM, {cores} cores")
PYTUNE

changed=$(git status --porcelain | wc -l)
echo "PATCH_APPLIED files=$changed"
if [ "$changed" -lt 80 ]; then
  echo "ERROR: only $changed files changed; a complete apply touches ~87." >&2
  exit 1
fi

475:     internal fun formatLastPlayed(ms: Long, now: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()): String {
476:         if (ms <= 0L) return ""
477:         fun startOfDay(ts: Long): Long {
478:             val cal = java.util.Calendar.getInstance()
479:             cal.timeInMillis = ts
480:             cal.set(java.util.Calendar.HOUR_OF_DAY, 0)
481:             cal.set(java.util.Calendar.MINUTE, 0)
482:             cal.set(java.util.Calendar.SECOND, 0)
483:             cal.set(java.util.Calendar.MILLISECOND, 0)
484:             return cal.timeInMillis
485:         }
486:         val startToday = startOfDay(now)
487:         val day = 24L * 3600_000

489:             ms >= startToday -> {
490:                 val cal = java.util.Calendar.getInstance()
491:                 cal.timeInMillis = ms
492:                 "сегодня %02d:%02d".format(cal.get(java.util.Calendar.HOUR_OF_DAY), cal.get(java.util.Calendar.MINUTE))

494:             ms >= startToday - day -> "вчера"
495:             else -> {

497:                 cal.timeInMillis = ms
498:                 "%02d.%02d".format(cal.get(java.util.Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH), cal.get(java.util.Calendar.MONTH) + 1)
