41: 
42:     /** Файл этого типа эмулятор запустить не сможет. */
43:     fun isLaunchable(name: String): Boolean = GameFormats.isLaunchable(name)
44: 
45:     /**
46:      * Плоский список файлов игр ровно в этой папке, без захода вглубь.
47:      *
48:      * Отдельно от [listGames], потому что вопросы разные: тот отвечает
49:      * "что импортирует библиотека", а этот - "что лежит в папке". Без
50:      * рекурсии, без фильтра по тому, примет ли файл эмулятор, и без
51:      * ограничения по количеству.
52:      */
53:     fun listFilesFlat(context: Context, uriString: String): List<Entry> {
54:         val resolver = context.applicationContext.contentResolver
55:         val tree = runCatching { Uri.parse(uriString) }.getOrNull() ?: return emptyList()
56:         val children = childrenUriFor(tree) ?: return emptyList()
57:         val out = mutableListOf<Entry>()
58:         val cursor = runCatching {
59:             resolver.query(
60:                 children,
61:                 arrayOf(
62:                     DocumentsContract.Document.COLUMN_DISPLAY_NAME,
63:                     DocumentsContract.Document.COLUMN_MIME_TYPE,
64:                     DocumentsContract.Document.COLUMN_SIZE
65:                 ),
66:                 null, null, null
67:             )
68:         }.getOrNull() ?: return emptyList()
69: 
70:         runCatching {
71:             cursor.use {
72:                 while (it.moveToNext()) {
73:                     if (out.size >= MAX_ENTRIES) break
74:                     val name = it.getString(0) ?: continue
75:                     val mime = it.getString(1) ?: ""
76:                     val size = if (it.isNull(2)) 0L else it.getLong(2)
77:                     if (mime == DocumentsContract.Document.MIME_TYPE_DIR) continue
78:                     val ext = name.substringAfterLast('.', "").lowercase(Locale.ROOT)
79:                     if (ext in SHOWABLE_EXTENSIONS || name.lowercase(Locale.ROOT) in ROM_FILENAMES) {
80:                         out.add(Entry(name, size))
81:                     }
82:                 }
83:             }
84:         }
85:         return out.sortedByDescending { it.bytes }
86:     }
87: 
88:     /**
89:      * Filenames that are a game without having a game's extension.
90:      *
91:      * loader.cpp:GuessFromFilename treats a file literally called "main" as a
92:      * DeconstructedRomDirectory - an unpacked game, where the folder is the
93:      * title and "main" is its executable - and "00" as an NCA, which is how a
94:      * split dump names its first part. Both are ordinary in real libraries and
95:      * both were invisible here: the scanner only looked at extensions, so an
96:      * unpacked game showed up as an empty folder.
97:      */
98:     private val ROM_FILENAMES = GameFormats.NAMES
99: 
100:     /** True when this file is something the emulator can load. */
101:     private fun isRom(name: String): Boolean = GameFormats.isLaunchable(name)
102: 
103:     /**
104:      * Extensions that look like content but are never listed as games.
105:      *
106:      * Worth naming separately so the folder screen can say "3 files here are
107:      * not launchable" instead of pretending the folder is empty.
108:      */
109:     private val NON_GAME_EXTENSIONS = setOf("nso", "kip", "bin", "zip", "7z", "rar")
110: 
111:     data class Folder(
112:         val uriString: String,
113:         /** Last path segment, which is what the user recognises. */
114:         val displayName: String,
115:         val gameCount: Int,
116:         val totalBytes: Long,
117:         /** Files with a ROM-ish extension the library will not import. */
118:         val skipped: Int = 0,
119:         /** Depth this folder was scanned at, so the file list can match. */
120:         val depth: Int = 1,
121:         /** True when the folder could not be read at all. */
122:         val unreadable: Boolean = false
123:     )
124: 
125:     /**
126:      * Scans every configured game folder.
127:      *
128:      * Always descends into subdirectories, regardless of the folder's
129:      * `deep_scan` flag. That flag governs what the emulator's own library
130:      * importer does; using it here made the count depend on a setting the user
131:      * cannot see from this screen, and let the count disagree with the file
132:      * list beside it. A storage summary that says "14 games" must mean the same
133:      * fourteen files the list can show. [MAX_DIRECTORIES] keeps a pathological
134:      * tree from turning that into a hang.
135:      */
136:     fun scan(context: Context, stillWanted: () -> Boolean = { true }): List<Folder> {
137:         val dirs = runCatching { NativeConfig.getGameDirs() }.getOrNull() ?: return emptyList()
138:         return dirs.map { dir ->
139:             scanOne(context, dir.uriString, depthFor(dir.deepScan), stillWanted)
140:         }
141:     }
142: 
143:     /**
144:      * How deep the library looks: GameHelper uses 3 with deep scan on and 1
145:      * without, counting the folder itself as one level.
146:      *
147:      * Matching it matters. This used to walk the whole tree regardless, so a
148:      * game two directories down was counted here and ignored by the importer,
149:      * and the strip claimed a game the list could never show.
150:      */
151:     fun depthFor(deepScan: Boolean): Int = if (deepScan) 3 else 1
152: 
153:     /**
154:      * Subdirectories [SharedDataDirectory.ensureLayout] creates under the
155:      * data root. They are not a game library. Walking them on a 8 GB Mali
156:      * phone is what turned "search for games" into a crash: nand alone is
157:      * hundreds of NCAs, cache/shader grows without bound, and a parent
158:      * folder stacked on its child sent the walker through the same tree
159:      * twice.
160:      */
161:     private val LAYOUT_NAMES = setOf(
162:         "nand", "load", "cache", "sdmc", "keys", "config",
163:         "dump", "screenshots", "amiibo", "tas", "icons", "log",
164:         "play_time", "crash_dumps", "shader", "system", "contents",
165:         "registered", "user", "save"
166:     )
167: 
168:     fun isLayoutName(name: String): Boolean =
169:         name.lowercase(Locale.ROOT) in LAYOUT_NAMES
170: 
171:     /**
172:      * The comparable path of a SAF URI or a file path.
173:      * `content://…/tree/primary:Download/ed` and the same URI percent-encoded
174:      * both become `download/ed`, so a parent/child check does not depend on
175:      * how Android handed the string over.
176:      */
177:     fun pathOf(uri: String): String {
178:         val decoded = runCatching { Uri.decode(uri) }.getOrDefault(uri)
179:         val afterScheme = decoded.substringAfter("://", decoded)
180:         val tail = if (':' in afterScheme) decoded.substringAfterLast(':') else decoded
181:         return tail.trim('/').lowercase(Locale.ROOT)
182:     }
183: 
184:     /**
185:      * Drop a folder that is a parent of another selected folder, and drop
186:      * exact duplicates keeping the first. Nothing is invented: an empty
187:      * list stays empty, a single chosen folder stays that folder.
188:      *
189:      * This is the "folders in layers" report. A default `game_path` plus
190:      * the folder the user actually picked meant walking the parent (often
191:      * the data root) and the child, so nand/load/cache got scanned on top
192:      * of the real library and the launch died in the walker.
193:      */
194:     fun collapseLayers(uris: List<String>): List<String> {
195:         val paths = uris.map { pathOf(it) }
196:         val keep = BooleanArray(uris.size) { true }
197:         for (i in uris.indices) {
198:             for (j in uris.indices) {
199:                 if (i == j || !keep[i]) continue
200:                 val a = paths[i]
201:                 val b = paths[j]
202:                 if (a.isEmpty()) continue
203:                 if (b.startsWith("$a/")) keep[i] = false
204:                 if (a == b && j < i) keep[i] = false
205:             }
206:         }
207:         return uris.filterIndexed { i, _ -> keep[i] }
208:     }
209: 
210:     /** Scan one folder, for callers that have a uri rather than the config. */
211:     fun scanOneFolder(
212:         context: Context,
213:         uriString: String,
214:         deepScan: Boolean,
215:         stillWanted: () -> Boolean = { true }
216:     ): Folder = scanOne(context, uriString, depthFor(deepScan), stillWanted)
217: 
218:     /**
219:      * @param stillWanted спрашивается перед каждым каталогом. Отмена
220:      *   корутины НЕ прерывает обычный цикл и не выставляет флаг
221:      *   прерывания потока - Dispatchers.IO просто отпускает результат, а
222:      *   код продолжает читать диск. Поэтому признак передаётся явно.
223:      */
224:     private fun scanOne(
225:         context: Context,
226:         uriString: String,
227:         maxDepth: Int,
228:         stillWanted: () -> Boolean = { true }
229:     ): Folder {
230:         // Контекст приложения, а не тот, что передали.
231:         //
232:         // Обход папки живёт секунды, а вызывают его из фрагмента, который
233:         // за это время может закрыться - поворот экрана, уход в
234:         // «Настройки» за разрешением. Курсор ContentResolver держит
235:         // ссылку на контекст: если это контекст фрагмента, вся активность
236:         // вместе с макетами остаётся в памяти до конца обхода. У этого
237:         // экрана обход запускается при каждом onResume, и каждый поворот
238:         // добавлял ещё одну утёкшую активность.
239:         val resolver = context.applicationContext.contentResolver
240:         val name = displayNameOf(uriString)
241:         val tree = runCatching { Uri.parse(uriString) }.getOrNull()
242:             ?: return Folder(uriString, name, 0, 0, depth = maxDepth, unreadable = true)
243: 
244:         var count = 0
245:         var bytes = 0L
246:         var skipped = 0
247:         var readable = false
248: 
249:         // Iterative rather than recursive: a pathological tree should not be
250:         // able to overflow the stack on a screen this trivial.
251:         val queue = ArrayDeque<Pair<Uri, Int>>()
252:         queue.add((childrenUriFor(tree)
253:             ?: return Folder(uriString, name, 0, 0, depth = maxDepth, unreadable = true)) to maxDepth)
254: 
255:         var guard = 0
256:         val seen = HashSet<String>()
257:         while (queue.isNotEmpty() && guard < MAX_DIRECTORIES) {
258:             guard++
259:             // Прервать обход, когда результат уже никому не нужен.
260:             //
261:             // Экран закрыли или запросили новый обход: до 400 запросов к
262:             // хранилищу, каждый со своим курсором, продолжались бы
263:             // впустую. Пользователь ушёл, а телефон ещё несколько секунд
264:             // читает диск.
265:             if (!stillWanted()) break
266:             val (children, depth) = queue.removeFirst()
267:             val cursor = runCatching {
268:                 resolver.query(
269:                     children,
270:                     arrayOf(
271:                         DocumentsContract.Document.COLUMN_DOCUMENT_ID,
272:                         DocumentsContract.Document.COLUMN_DISPLAY_NAME,
273:                         DocumentsContract.Document.COLUMN_MIME_TYPE,
274:                         DocumentsContract.Document.COLUMN_SIZE
275:                     ),
276:                     null, null, null
277:                 )
278:             }.getOrNull() ?: continue
279: 
280:             readable = true
281:             // cursor.use закрывает курсор при выходе, НО не при исключении
282:             // внутри самого перебора: getString на битой строке кидает, и
283:             // раньше это исключение уходило наверх, обрывая весь обход.
284:             // Одна нечитаемая запись делала папку целиком "пустой".
285:             runCatching {
286:             cursor.use {
287:                 while (it.moveToNext()) {
288:                     val documentId = it.getString(0)
289:                     val displayName = it.getString(1) ?: ""
290:                     val mimeType = it.getString(2) ?: ""
291:                     val size = if (it.isNull(3)) 0L else it.getLong(3)
292: 
293:                     if (mimeType == DocumentsContract.Document.MIME_TYPE_DIR) {
294:                         // Пускать в очередь только новые каталоги.
295:                         //
296:                         // Провайдер вполне может вернуть один и тот же
297:                         // documentId дважды: сетевые и облачные хранилища
298:                         // делают это на папках, доступных по нескольким
299:                         // путям. Раньше такая пара каталогов гоняла обход
300:                         // по кругу, пока не упрётся в лимит 400 - и
301:                         // считала одни и те же файлы много раз.
302:                         if (depth > 1 && documentId != null && seen.add(documentId)) {
303:                             runCatching {
304:                                 queue.add(
305:                                     DocumentsContract.buildChildDocumentsUriUsingTree(
306:                                         tree, documentId
307:                                     ) to depth - 1
308:                                 )
309:                             }
310:                         }
311:                         continue
312:                     }
313: 
314:                     val ext = displayName.substringAfterLast('.', "").lowercase(Locale.ROOT)
315:                     if (isRom(displayName)) {
316:                         count++
317:                         bytes += size
318:                     } else if (ext in NON_GAME_EXTENSIONS) {
319:                         skipped++
320:                     }
321:                 }
322:             }
323:             }
324:         }
325: 
326:         return Folder(uriString, name, count, bytes, skipped, maxDepth, unreadable = !readable)
327:     }
328: 
329:     data class Entry(
330:         val name: String,
331:         val bytes: Long,
332:         /** Sub-path below the folder root, empty when the file sits at the top. */
333:         val relativePath: String = ""
334:     )
335: 
336:     /**
337:      * Lists the ROMs inside one folder.
338:      *
339:      * Descends into subdirectories, because [scanOne] does. When the two
340:      * disagreed the screen said "14 games" and then listed none of them: the
341:      * count walked the whole tree while this only ever read the top level, so
342:      * a library organised one-folder-per-game - which is the normal way to
343:      * keep them - looked empty. Anything the counter counts must be listable,
344:      * or the count is a lie.
345:      *
346:      * Read at the moment of asking rather than served from the library cache,
347:      * so a file copied over USB a second ago is listed and one deleted a second
348:      * ago is not.
349:      */
350:     fun listGames(
351:         context: Context,
352:         uriString: String,
353:         maxDepth: Int = 1,
354:         stillWanted: () -> Boolean = { true }
355:     ): List<Entry> {
356:         val resolver = context.applicationContext.contentResolver
357:         val tree = runCatching { Uri.parse(uriString) }.getOrNull() ?: return emptyList()
358:         val root = childrenUriFor(tree) ?: return emptyList()
359:         val out = mutableListOf<Entry>()
360: 
361:         // Same walk, same guard and the same depth as the counter, so the two
362:         // cannot drift apart again.
363:         val queue = ArrayDeque<Triple<Uri, String, Int>>()
364:         queue.add(Triple(root, "", maxDepth))
365:         var guard = 0
366:         val seen = HashSet<String>()
367: 
368:         while (queue.isNotEmpty() && guard < MAX_DIRECTORIES) {
369:             guard++
370:             if (!stillWanted()) break
371:             // Верхняя граница на размер ответа.
372:             //
373:             // Список строился без ограничений, а каждая запись - это
374:             // три строки. На папке с несколькими тысячами файлов (обычное
375:             // дело для дампа) он занимал десятки мегабайт, и всё это
376:             // передавалось в адаптер разом. На 3 ГБ памяти это тот самый
377:             // вылет по нехватке памяти при открытии папки.
378:             if (out.size >= MAX_ENTRIES) break
379:             val (children, prefix, depth) = queue.removeFirst()
380:             val cursor = runCatching {
381:                 resolver.query(
382:                     children,
383:                     arrayOf(
384:                         DocumentsContract.Document.COLUMN_DOCUMENT_ID,
385:                         DocumentsContract.Document.COLUMN_DISPLAY_NAME,
386:                         DocumentsContract.Document.COLUMN_MIME_TYPE,
387:                         DocumentsContract.Document.COLUMN_SIZE
388:                     ),
389:                     null, null, null
390:                 )
391:             }.getOrNull() ?: continue
392: 
393:             runCatching {
394:             cursor.use {
395:                 while (it.moveToNext()) {
396:                     if (out.size >= MAX_ENTRIES) break
397:                     val documentId = it.getString(0)
398:                     val name = it.getString(1) ?: continue
399:                     val mime = it.getString(2) ?: ""
400:                     val size = if (it.isNull(3)) 0L else it.getLong(3)
401: 
402:                     if (mime == DocumentsContract.Document.MIME_TYPE_DIR) {
403:                         if (depth > 1 &&
404:                             documentId != null &&
405:                             seen.add(documentId) &&
406:                             !isLayoutName(name)
407:                         ) {
408:                             runCatching {
409:                                 queue.add(
410:                                     Triple(
411:                                         DocumentsContract.buildChildDocumentsUriUsingTree(tree, documentId),
412:                                         if (prefix.isEmpty()) name else "$prefix/$name",
413:                                         depth - 1
414:                                     )
415:                                 )
416:                             }
417:                         }
418:                         continue
419:                     }
420: 
421:                     if (isRom(name)) {
422:                         out.add(Entry(name, size, prefix))
423:                     }
424:                 }
425:             }
426:             }
427:         }
428:         return out.sortedByDescending { it.bytes }
429:     }
430: 
431:     private fun childrenUriFor(tree: Uri): Uri? = runCatching {
432:         DocumentsContract.buildChildDocumentsUriUsingTree(
433:             tree,
434:             DocumentsContract.getTreeDocumentId(tree)
435:         )
436:     }.getOrNull()
437: 
438:     /**
439:      * The document URI of a file this scanner listed.
440:      *
441:      * The scanner records a name and a sub-path rather than a URI, because a
442:      * URI is large and most callers only want to count. Rebuilding it here
443:      * keeps that trade without making the folder screen re-walk the tree.
444:      *
445:      * Document ids under a tree are the tree's own id plus the relative path,
446:      * which is how the storage framework addresses children; when a provider
447:      * does not follow that shape the caller gets null and says so rather than
448:      * launching something wrong.
449:      */
450:     fun childUri(treeUriString: String, entry: Entry): Uri? = runCatching {
451:         val tree = Uri.parse(treeUriString)
452:         val rootId = DocumentsContract.getTreeDocumentId(tree)
453:         val suffix = if (entry.relativePath.isEmpty()) entry.name
454:                      else entry.relativePath + "/" + entry.name
455:         val childId = if (rootId.endsWith("/")) rootId + suffix else "$rootId/$suffix"
456:         DocumentsContract.buildDocumentUriUsingTree(tree, childId)
457:     }.getOrNull()
458: 
459:     /** The part of the path a person would call the folder's name. */
460:     fun displayNameOf(uriString: String): String {
461:         val decoded = runCatching { Uri.decode(uriString) }.getOrDefault(uriString)
462:         val tail = decoded.substringAfterLast(':', decoded.substringAfterLast('/'))
463:         return tail.substringAfterLast('/').ifBlank { decoded }
464:     }
465: 
466:     /**
467:      * Total bytes under a plain filesystem directory.
468:      *
469:      * Keys, firmware, saves and the shader cache live in the data root as
470:      * ordinary files, not behind a document tree, so they are measured with
471:      * [java.io.File] rather than the content resolver. Returns 0 for a missing
472:      * directory, which is the honest answer for "nothing installed".
473:      */
474:     fun directoryBytes(path: String?): Long {
475:         if (path.isNullOrBlank()) return 0L
476:         val root = java.io.File(path)
477:         if (!root.exists()) return 0L
478:         if (root.isFile) return root.length()
479: 
480:         var total = 0L
481:         var guard = 0
482:         val queue = ArrayDeque<java.io.File>()
483:         queue.add(root)
484:         while (queue.isNotEmpty() && guard < MAX_DIRECTORIES) {
485:             guard++
486:             val entries = queue.removeFirst().listFiles() ?: continue
487:             for (entry in entries) {
488:                 if (entry.isDirectory) queue.add(entry) else total += entry.length()
489:             }
490:         }
491:         return total
492:     }
493: 
494:     /** Formats bytes the way a storage screen would. */
495:     fun humanSize(bytes: Long): String {
496:         if (bytes <= 0) return "0 MB"
497:         val gb = bytes / 1_073_741_824.0
498:         if (gb >= 1.0) return String.format(Locale.US, "%.1f GB", gb)
499:         val mb = bytes / 1_048_576.0
500:         if (mb >= 1.0) return String.format(Locale.US, "%.0f MB", mb)
501:         return String.format(Locale.US, "%.0f KB", bytes / 1024.0)
502:     }
503: 
504:     /** Stops a symlink loop or an absurd tree from hanging the scan. */
505:     private const val MAX_DIRECTORIES = 400
506: 
507:     /**
508:      * Потолок на длину списка файлов.
509:      *
510:      * Не про «столько игр не бывает», а про память: список целиком лежит
511:      * в куче и целиком уходит в адаптер. Три тысячи строк экран всё равно
512:      * не покажет осмысленно, а вылет по нехватке памяти покажет.
513:      */
514:     private const val MAX_ENTRIES = 3000
515: }

64:         // firstStartup лишь ПРЕДВАРИТЕЛЬНО показывает кэш, а сразу за
65:         // этим безусловно идёт setGames(GameHelper.getGames()) - полный
66:         // обход дерева с разбором заголовка каждого ROM. То есть кэш
67:         // существовал, но не экономил ничего: каждый запуск заново читал
68:         // и расшифровывал все файлы.

140:     fun reloadGames(directoriesChanged: Boolean, firstStartup: Boolean = false) {
141:         // Запрос, пришедший во время идущего обхода, раньше просто
142:         // выбрасывался - `return`, и всё. А обход папок при старте длится
143:         // секунды: пользователь успевает выбрать папку ровно в это окно,
144:         // его запрос теряется, и папка снова "не появляется до
145:         // перезапуска". Второй случай той же жалобы.
146:         //
147:         // Теперь такой запрос запоминается и выполняется сразу после
148:         // текущего.
149:         if (!reloading.compareAndSet(false, true)) {
150:             rescanRequested.set(true)
151:             return
152:         }
153:         _isReloading.value = true
154: 
155:         viewModelScope.launch {
156:             withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
157:                 try {
158:                     if (firstStartup) {
159:                         // Retrieve list of cached games
160:                         val storedGames =
161:                             PreferenceManager.getDefaultSharedPreferences(YuzuApplication.appContext)
162:                                 .getStringSet(GameHelper.KEY_GAMES, emptySet())
163:                         if (storedGames!!.isNotEmpty()) {
164:                             val deserializedGames = mutableSetOf<Game>()
165:                             storedGames.forEach {
166:                                 val game: Game
167:                                 try {
168:                                     game = Json.decodeFromString(it)
169:                                 } catch (e: Exception) {
170:                                     // We don't care about any errors related to parsing the game cache
171:                                     return@forEach
172:                                 }
173: 
174:                                 val gameExists =
175:                                     DocumentFile.fromSingleUri(
176:                                         YuzuApplication.appContext,
177:                                         Uri.parse(game.path)
178:                                     )?.exists()
179:                                 if (gameExists == true) {
180:                                     deserializedGames.add(game)
181:                                 }
182:                             }
183:                             setGames(deserializedGames.toList())
184:                         }
185:                     }
186: 
187:                     setGames(GameHelper.getGames())
188:                     _shouldScrollAfterReload.value = true
189: 
190:                     if (directoriesChanged) {
191:                         setShouldSwapData(true)
192:                     }
193:                 } catch (e: Exception) {
194:                     // Обход не должен ронять приложение. Раньше исключение
195:                     // из GameHelper.getGames() - битый файл, отозванный
196:                     // доступ - уходило наверх из корутины.
197:                     //
198:                     // Unit в конце обязателен: Log.e возвращает Int, и без
199:                     // него try/catch становится выражением типа Any, а
200:                     // тогда Kotlin требует else у if внутри try.
201:                     android.util.Log.e("Symbiosis", "не удалось прочитать список игр", e)
202:                     Unit
203:                 } finally {
204:                     reloading.set(false)
205:                     _isReloading.value = false
206:                 }
207:             }
208: 
209:             // Кто-то просил обновиться, пока мы работали.
210:             if (rescanRequested.compareAndSet(true, false)) {
211:                 reloadGames(directoriesChanged = true, firstStartup = false)
212:             }
213:         }
214:     }
215: 
216:     /** Запрос на обход, пришедший во время другого обхода. */
217:     private val rescanRequested = AtomicBoolean(false)
218: 
219:     fun addFolder(gameDir: GameDir, savedFromGameFragment: Boolean) =
220:         viewModelScope.launch {
221:             // The user is editing the list, so any remembered copy is now
222:             // stale. Keeping it resurrects removed folders on the next start
223:             // and makes re-adding one fail with "already added".
224:             org.yuzu.yuzu_emu.utils.SharedDataDirectory.forgetGameDirs()
225:             withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
226:                 when (gameDir.type) {
227:                     DirectoryType.GAME -> {
228:                         NativeConfig.addGameDir(gameDir)
229:                         // ПОЧЕМУ ПАПКА ПОЯВЛЯЛАСЬ ТОЛЬКО ПОСЛЕ ПЕРЕЗАПУСКА
230:                         //
231:                         // Здесь стояло getGameDirsAndExternalContent(
232:                         //     !isFirstTimeSetup)
233:                         // то есть: перечитать список игр, только если
234:                         // "первый запуск" уже пройден. Флаг снимался
235:                         // РОВНО В ОДНОМ месте - в finishSetup() мастера
236:                         // первичной настройки. Мастер из этой сборки
237:                         // удалён, значит finishSetup() не вызывается
238:                         // никогда, значит PREF_FIRST_APP_LAUNCH остаётся
239:                         // true навсегда, значит reloadGames не звался
240:                         // никогда.
241:                         //
242:                         // Папка при этом добавлялась в конфиг честно -
243:                         // поэтому после перезапуска игры и появлялись:
244:                         // при старте список читается сам. Выглядело как
245:                         // "приложение не видит папку, пока не
246:                         // перезапустишь", а на деле оно её видело и
247:                         // просто не обновляло экран.
248:                         //
249:                         // Условие убрано целиком. Пользователь только что
250:                         // выбрал папку - перечитать список нужно всегда,
251:                         // безусловно.
252:                         getGameDirsAndExternalContent(reloadList = true)
253:                     }
254:                     DirectoryType.EXTERNAL_CONTENT -> {
255:                         addExternalContentDir(gameDir.uriString)
256:                         NativeConfig.saveGlobalConfig()
257:                         getGameDirsAndExternalContent()
258:                     }
259:                 }
260:             }
261: 
262:             if (savedFromGameFragment) {
263:                 NativeConfig.saveGlobalConfig()
264:                 Toast.makeText(
265:                     YuzuApplication.appContext,
266:                     R.string.add_directory_success,
267:                     Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
268:                 ).show()
269:             }
270:         }
271: 
272:     fun removeFolder(gameDir: GameDir) =
273:         viewModelScope.launch {
274:             // The user is editing the list, so any remembered copy is now
275:             // stale. Keeping it resurrects removed folders on the next start
276:             // and makes re-adding one fail with "already added".
277:             org.yuzu.yuzu_emu.utils.SharedDataDirectory.forgetGameDirs()
278:             withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
279:                 val gameDirs = _folders.value.toMutableList()
280:                 val removedDirIndex = gameDirs.indexOf(gameDir)
281:                 if (removedDirIndex != -1) {
282:                     gameDirs.removeAt(removedDirIndex)
283:                     when (gameDir.type) {
284:                         DirectoryType.GAME -> {
285:                             NativeConfig.setGameDirs(gameDirs.filter { it.type == DirectoryType.GAME }.toTypedArray())
286:                         }
287:                         DirectoryType.EXTERNAL_CONTENT -> {
288:                             removeExternalContentDir(gameDir.uriString)
289:                         }
290:                     }
291:                     getGameDirsAndExternalContent()
292:                 }
293:             }
294:         }
295: 
296:     fun updateGameDirs() =
297:         viewModelScope.launch {
298:             withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
299:                 val gameDirs = _folders.value.filter { it.type == DirectoryType.GAME }
300:                 NativeConfig.setGameDirs(gameDirs.toTypedArray())
301:                 getGameDirsAndExternalContent()
302:             }
303:         }
304: 
305:     fun onOpenGameFoldersFragment() =
306:         viewModelScope.launch {
307:             withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
308:                 getGameDirsAndExternalContent()
309:             }
310:         }
311: 
312:     fun onCloseGameFoldersFragment() {
313:         NativeConfig.saveGlobalConfig()
314:         viewModelScope.launch {
315:             withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
316:                 getGameDirsAndExternalContent(true)
317:             }
318:         }
319:     }
320: 
321:     private fun getGameDirsAndExternalContent(reloadList: Boolean = false) {
322:         val gameDirs = NativeConfig.getGameDirs().toMutableList()
323:         val externalContentDirs = NativeConfig.getExternalContentDirs().map {
324:             GameDir(it, false, DirectoryType.EXTERNAL_CONTENT)
325:         }
326:         gameDirs.addAll(externalContentDirs)
327:         _folders.value = gameDirs
328:         if (reloadList) {
329:             reloadGames(true)
330:         }
331:     }
332: 
333:     private fun addExternalContentDir(path: String) {
334:         val currentDirs = NativeConfig.getExternalContentDirs().toMutableList()
335:         if (!currentDirs.contains(path)) {
336:             currentDirs.add(path)
337:             NativeConfig.setExternalContentDirs(currentDirs.toTypedArray())
338:             NativeConfig.saveGlobalConfig()
339:         }
340:     }
341: 
342:     private fun removeExternalContentDir(path: String) {
343:         val currentDirs = NativeConfig.getExternalContentDirs().toMutableList()
344:         currentDirs.remove(path)
345:         NativeConfig.setExternalContentDirs(currentDirs.toTypedArray())
346:         NativeConfig.saveGlobalConfig()
347:     }
348: }

parts.text:
Now LivePanel.kt (full) and LivePanelFragment.kt, and GamesViewModel's `getGameDirsAndExternalContent` — done.

Key finding: `GamesViewModel.init` does NOT call `reloadGames`; it only calls `loadCachedGames()`. So the game list at startup = whatever is in SharedPreferences `GameHelper.KEY_GAMES`. If the previous scan only found 1 game, only 1 shows until pull-to-refresh. This is a genuine "one game" risk worth reporting.

Also `reloadGames(firstStartup=true)` still does `setGames(GameHelper.getGames())` at line 187 unconditionally after the cached preview — so the "lazy" firstStartup path still walks.

Also note `loadCachedGames()` only calls setGames when cached is non-empty (line 102) — empty cache leaves `_games` empty, which is correct.

370:     private fun fileBytes(dir: File): Long {
371:         if (!dir.exists()) return 0
372:         if (dir.isFile) return dir.length()
373:         var sum = 0L
374:         val q = ArrayDeque<File>()
375:         q.add(dir)
376:         var steps = 0
377:         while (q.isNotEmpty() && steps < 80) {
378:             steps++
379:             val kids = q.removeFirst().listFiles() ?: continue
380:             for (k in kids) {
381:                 if (k.isFile) sum += k.length() else if (k.isDirectory) q.add(k)
382:             }
383:         }
384:         return sum
385:     }

392:             steps++
393:             val cur = q.removeFirst()
394:             val kids = cur.listFiles() ?: continue
395:             for (k in kids) {
396:                 if (k.isFile && k.length() > 0) return true
397:                 if (k.isDirectory) q.add(k)
398:             }
399:         }
400:         return false
401:     }

164:         val view = WebView(requireContext())
165:         web = view

172:         // прятал заголовок и кнопки под статус-бар на одних прошивках
173:         // и оставлял дыру на других.
174:         view.webViewClient = object : WebViewClient() {
175:             override fun onReceivedError(
176:                 v: WebView?,
177:                 request: WebResourceRequest?,
178:                 error: WebResourceError?
179:             ) {
180:                 if (request?.isForMainFrame == true) {
181:                     v?.loadUrl(LivePanel.OFFLINE_URL)
182:                 }
183:             }
184:         }
185:         // Сразу assets: Pages без сети мигал пустым экраном.
186:         view.loadUrl(LivePanel.OFFLINE_URL)

parts.text:
Very important finding: `LivePanel.rememberedGames()` at line 85-106 returns `emptyList()` if `!keysPresent()`. So if prod.keys are not loaded/present, the WebView launcher shows ZERO games — the panel's game list is empty. This is a real "one game"/empty-list risk: keys gate.

Also `rememberedGames` prefers `GameHelper.cachedGameList` and only falls back to prefs. It never scans disk. So the WebView launcher shows exactly what the last scan produced. If the last scan found 1 game, only 1 shows. There is no rescanning from the panel except `Symbiosis.rescan()` (line 438) which calls `gamesViewModel.reloadGames(false)`.

Note: `reloadGames(false)` with `firstStartup = false` → skips the cached preview and goes straight to `setGames(GameHelper.getGames())` at line 187. Good.

BUT: `Bridge.rescan()` at 438-442 posts to main thread and calls `gamesViewModel.reloadGames(false)`. The `gamesViewModel` is `by activityViewModels()` — shared. And `GamesFragment` observes `games` StateFlow. However `LivePanel.games()` reads `GameHelper.cachedGameList` which is set by `GameHelper.getGames()` at line 123 of GameHelper. So after a rescan the panel's `games()` returns fresh data. Good. But the panel must call `loadGames()` again — `loadGames()` is only invoked on page load, `onFolderAdded`, and `reloadPageData()`. Confirmed: `GamesFragment.kt:229-233` — `if (it.isNotEmpty()) setAdapter(it)`. Empty emission leaves the previous adapter list intact (stale list shown, and `noticeText` becomes visible at line 224-227 showing the "empty" hint *over* a stale list). That's a real state bug worth reporting.

Also `GameFoldersFragment.kt:223-230 onResume → rescan()` — the folder screen does a full walk on every resume (with `isActive` cancellation).

Also `GamesFragment.kt:727-756` — folder cards are built from the cache (`GameFolderScanner.Folder` constructed from cached games), no walk.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Builds and runs the host test suite against a patched Eden checkout.
#
# Two things here are easy to get wrong and both make the suite worthless:
#
#  1. Do NOT put <eden>/src/common on the include path. Eden ships its own
#     common/assert.h, which shadows the standard <cassert>; every assert()
#     then expands to nothing and the tests pass without checking anything.
#     Only -I<eden>/src is correct.
#
#  2. Eden's logging is a real dependency of the layer. Rather than linking
#     half the emulator, a tiny stub supplies FmtLogMessageImpl.
#
# Usage: bash tools/run_tests.sh [--eden <dir>]
set -uo pipefail

EDEN_DIR="${EDEN_DIR:-/tmp/citest}"
# A test that will not link proves nothing. Allow a known few (they need most
# of video_core), but fail if the number grows - that means the environment is
# broken, not the code.
MAX_SKIP="${MAX_SKIP:-99}"
while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
  case "$1" in
    --max-skip) MAX_SKIP="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --eden) EDEN_DIR="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    *) echo "unknown argument: $1" >&2; exit 2 ;;
  esac
done

E="$EDEN_DIR"
S="$E/src/common/symbiosis"
[ -d "$S" ] || { echo "patched Eden not found at $E (run tools/apply_patch.sh first)" >&2; exit 1; }

HERE="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"

# Eden's logging.h needs fmt 10 (format.get()); Ubuntu ships fmt 9. Point
# FMT_INCLUDE at a fmt 10 checkout to build against that instead. FMT_HEADER_ONLY
# avoids needing the compiled library at all.
FMT_FLAGS=""
if [ -n "${FMT_INCLUDE:-}" ]; then
  FMT_FLAGS="-isystem $FMT_INCLUDE -DFMT_HEADER_ONLY"
  LINK_FMT=""
else
  LINK_FMT="-lfmt"
fi
BUILD=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$BUILD"' EXIT

# Minimal stand-in for Eden's logging backend.
cat > "$BUILD/log_stub.cpp" <<'STUB'
#include <cstdarg>
#include <string_view>
#include "common/logging.h"
namespace Common::Log {
void FmtLogMessageImpl(Class, Level, const char*, unsigned int, const char*,
                       fmt::string_view, const fmt::format_args&) {}
} // namespace Common::Log
STUB

CORE="$S/symbiosis_log.cpp $S/symbiosis_types.cpp $BUILD/log_stub.cpp"
# Settings::values lives here; several tests read or write real settings.
SETTINGS="$E/src/common/settings.cpp"

deps_for() {
  case "$1" in
    t_mali|t_parse) echo "$S/mali_tuning.cpp $CORE" ;;
    t_fw)           echo "$S/firmware_vault.cpp $CORE" ;;
    t_rom)          echo "$S/rom_tools.cpp $CORE" ;;
    t_save)         echo "$S/save_guard.cpp $S/thermal_monitor.cpp $CORE" ;;
    t_guard)        echo "$CORE" ;;
    t_modes)        echo "$S/auto_modes.cpp $S/device_profiles.cpp $SETTINGS $CORE" ;;
    t_uaf)          echo "$S/memory_governor.cpp $CORE" ;;
    t_v12)          echo "$S/device_profiles.cpp $S/auto_modes.cpp $SETTINGS $CORE" ;;
    t_fps)          echo "$S/device_profiles.cpp $S/auto_modes.cpp $SETTINGS $CORE" ;;
    *)              echo "" ;;
  esac
}

pass=0; fail=0; skip=0; failed=""
for f in "$HERE"/tests/t_*.cpp; do
  [ -e "$f" ] || continue
  n=$(basename "$f" .cpp)
  # shellcheck disable=SC2046
  # shellcheck disable=SC2086
  if g++ -std=c++20 -O1 $FMT_FLAGS -I"$E/src" -o "$BUILD/$n" "$f" $(deps_for "$n") $LINK_FMT \
       > "$BUILD/$n.err" 2>&1; then
    if out=$("$BUILD/$n" 2>&1); then
      echo "  PASS  $n — $(printf '%s' "$out" | tail -1)"; pass=$((pass+1))
    else
      echo "  FAIL  $n"; printf '%s\n' "$out" | tail -5 | sed 's/^/        /'
      fail=$((fail+1)); failed="$failed $n"
    fi
  else
    # A test whose dependencies are not wired up is reported, never hidden.
    # A test that will not build is reported with the real reason, never a
    # blank. An empty parenthesis told me nothing on CI and cost a whole run.
    reason=$(grep -m1 -E "undefined reference|error:|fatal error:" "$BUILD/$n.err" | head -1)
    echo "  SKIP  $n"
    echo "        reason: ${reason:-unknown}"
    sed 's/^/        | /' "$BUILD/$n.err" | head -6
    skip=$((skip+1))
  fi
done

# Kotlin tests, when a compiler is available.
if command -v kotlinc >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  for f in "$HERE"/tests/*.kt; do
    [ -e "$f" ] || continue
    n=$(basename "$f" .kt)
    kotlinc "$f" -include-runtime -d "$BUILD/$n.jar" 2>/dev/null
    # Run from the repository root. A test that reads its own subject - as
    # PanelAssetsTest does, checking docs/ and the shell source against the
    # copy of the routing logic it asserts - resolves those paths relative to
    # the working directory, and CI invokes this script from elsewhere. The JS
    # loop below already does this; the Kotlin one did not, so the same test
    # passed locally and failed on the runner.
    if out=$(cd "$HERE" && java -jar "$BUILD/$n.jar" 2>&1); then
      echo "  PASS  $n — $(printf '%s' "$out" | tail -1)"; pass=$((pass+1))
    else
      echo "  FAIL  $n"; printf '%s\n' "$out" | tail -8 | sed 's/^/        /'
      fail=$((fail+1)); failed="$failed $n"
    fi
  done
else
  echo "  note: kotlinc not on PATH, Kotlin tests not run"
fi

# Node tests. The capability layer spawns real interpreters, so these check
# actual process behaviour rather than a mock; they need node on PATH and
# python3 for the Python-runtime cases.
if command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  for f in "$HERE"/tests/*.js; do
    [ -e "$f" ] || continue
    n=$(basename "$f" .js)
    if out=$(cd "$HERE" && node "$f" 2>&1); then
      echo "  PASS  $n — $(printf '%s' "$out" | tail -1)"; pass=$((pass+1))
    else
      echo "  FAIL  $n"; printf '%s\n' "$out" | tail -15 | sed 's/^/        /'
      fail=$((fail+1)); failed="$failed $n"
    fi
  done
else
  echo "  note: node not on PATH, JS tests not run"
fi

echo
echo "passed=$pass failed=$fail skipped=$skip"
[ "$fail" -eq 0 ] || { echo "failing:$failed"; exit 1; }
if [ "$skip" -gt "$MAX_SKIP" ]; then
  echo "too many tests could not be built ($skip > $MAX_SKIP): the toolchain is"
  echo "missing something - libfmt-dev, or the patched Eden tree."
  exit 1
fi

Horizontal-navigation risks **H1. The rail has zero custom gesture handling — everything depends on the browser.** `library.html:223-232` only. If the WebView is not Chromium (or scroll-snap is disabled by a plugin), the rail degrades to a plain scroller with no snap and no keyboard support (there is no `keydown`/arrow handling anywhere). **H2. No drag suppression on the cover images — most likely real-world failure.** `.slide img` (`:242`) sets only `width/height/object-fit/display`. There is **no `user-select:none`, no `-webkit-user-drag:none`, no `draggable="false"`, no `-webkit-touch-callout:none`** anywhere in the file (grep for `draggable|user-select|-webkit-touch-callout` returns zero hits). The covers are `data:image/jpeg;base64` `` injected by `fillCover()` (`:800-806`). A long press on a cover is a native image-drag gesture on many Android WebViews, which pre-empts the horizontal swipe. **H3. `scrollIntoView` is the only positioning mechanism** (`:796`, `:816`, `:1393`, `:1495`). `scrollIntoView` scrolls **all scrollable ancestors**; with `block:'nearest'` it normally leaves the page alone, but it is the classic way a rail steals vertical scroll. There is no `rail.scrollTo({left: …})` fallback. **H4. `renderLauncher()` rebuilds the rail wholesale and re-centers — drops the user's place mid-gesture.** Called from three places: `loadGames()` (`:1076`, and `loadGames` runs from `findGames` polling at `:720`, from `onFolderAdded` at `:1129`, from `onSavesPicked` at `:1135`, from folder removal at `:1106`), `showTab('launch')` (`:1390`), and the tools sort/filter bar (`:1476`). Each call replaces `rail.innerHTML` (`:778`) and re-issues `scrollIntoView` in `requestAnimationFrame` (`:794-797`). A 700 ms rescan poll landing mid-swipe resets the rail to `LAUNCH_I`. **H5. `nearestSlide()` measures untransformed boxes while the slides are visually scaled.** `:826` uses `offsetLeft + offsetWidth/2`; `.slide` is `transform:scale(.88)` (`:238`) expanding to `scale(1)` when `.on` (`:241`). The centers are geometrically correct, but the highlighted tile and the tile the user perceives as centred can differ by the transform, and the `transform` is animating over 0.18 s (`:239`) while the 80 ms scroll debounce (`:1487`) fires — so `.on` can land on the previous tile during a fast flick. **H6. Landscape relayout.** `:344-359` switches slides to `min(28vh,180px)` and `padding:6px 44px`, and the rail-wrap to `flex:0 0 36%; max-width:320px` (`:351`). `keepLaunchFrame()` (`:1491-1505`) re-centers on `resize` and twice on `orientationchange`. Combined with `snapTo`'s `scrollIntoView`, a rotation during a fling can leave the rail between two snap points with `.on` set on one of them. **H7. In Kenji space there is no horizontal navigation at all.** `:341` `body.space-kenji #view-launch, #view-games { display:none !important; }` and `:342` hides the tabs; `paintSpaces()` (`:1531-1536`) shows `#view-kenji` with the vertical `#k-grid` (`:1562-1595`). `renderKenjiGrid` has its **own** search box (`:1565-1566`, wired at `:1626`) independent of `visibleGames()` — a second filter surface that can disagree with the Список tab. The «Их APK» button in that bar (`:1629-1632`) acts on `RAIL_LIST[LAUNCH_I]`, i.e. on the **hidden** rail's selection, which is not what the Kenji grid highlights — a genuine cross-surface mismatch. **H8. Portrait native screen has no horizontal pager.** `patch/android/layout/fragment_games.xml:318-359` is `SwipeRefreshLayout` → plain `RecyclerView`. The native carousel exists only in `layout-land/fragment_games.xml:336`. So the only place where a *parent view* could steal a horizontal gesture on the native side is `SwipeRefreshLayout` — I cannot verify its interception rules without the upstream `CarouselRecyclerView`/`SwipeRefreshLayout` sources. **H9. ViewHolder reuse across view types is guarded, but carousel restore is best-effort.** `GamesFragment.kt:328-330` forces a non-carousel view type on holders left over from the carousel, and `:356-362` re-runs `notifyLaidOut`/`setupCarousel`. `lastScrollPosition` (`:53` in the ViewModel) is a single `Int` shared by all view types, so switching grid→carousel→list→carousel restores a position computed for a different layout manager. ## 8.
